title: Analista De Negócios Sênior - Mercados De Capitais
description: Somos a única solução completa para o mercado financeiro! A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro, com mais de 27 anos de atuação no mercado, e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe e mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente. Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software, adquirência, processamento e tecnologias para meios de pagamento, contribuindo para a digitalização de instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs. Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica, a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros. Responsabilidades Colaborar com stakeholders de negócio para capturar, validar e transformar requisitos funcionais em especificações técnicas detalhadas, garantindo aderência às normas regulatórias dos mercados de capitais. Desenhar e documentar processos integração por meio de diagramas UML, BPMN, e diagramas de sequência, evidenciando fluxos de dados, pontos de contato, padrões de integração (REST, SOAP, Messaging, Event‑Driven) e acordos de nível de serviço (SLAs) – incluindo tempos de resposta, disponibilidade e políticas de retry. Elaborar especificações funcionais e não funcionais (performance, escalabilidade, resilência) e user stories que suportem evoluções de plataformas de negociação, análise de risco e sistemas de liquidação. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetos de solução e DevOps para assegurar que os artefatos de design sejam traduzidos em código robusto. Conduzir análises de impacto, provas de conceito (PoC) e estudos de viabilidade técnica, avaliando requisitos de volume de transações, latência e conformidade regulatória. Apoiar a resolução de incidentes de integração, monitorando métricas de desempenho, e promovendo ações corretivas para garantir alta disponibilidade e performance ideal. Coordenar testes de aceitação de usuário (UAT), testes de integração e de contrato, bem como preparar material de treinamento, documentação funcional e guias de operação. Manter atualizada a documentação de processos de negócio, diagramas, dicionários de dados, configurações de middleware e manuais de usuário. Qualificações Inglês funcional (leitura, escrita e conversação) para interação através de chat e tickets em ferramentas como ServiceNow. +5 anos de experiência como Analista de Negócios, preferencialmente em serviços financeiros, mercados de capitais ou corretoras de valores. Compreensão de arquiteturas de integração (SOA, micro‑serviços, ETLs) e domínio de protocolos e padrões: REST/JSON, SOAP/XML, gRPC, mensagens assíncronas (Kafka, MQ, AMQP). Experiência comprovada na criação de modelos UML/BPMN e na utilização de ferramentas de diagramas e modelagem (Enterprise Architect, Visio, Draw.Io, Lucidchart). Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra). Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos (JIRA, Confluence, X‑Ray) para rastreamento de histórias, testes e métricas de entrega. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal, capacidade de mediar entre áreas de negócio e técnicas. Proatividade e pensamento crítico. Modelo Híbrido: 3x Presencial no Itaim Bibi - SP Benefícios - O que você encontrará aqui: Assistência médica Vale refeição Auxílio creche Seguro de vida Vale transporte Benefícios Flexíveis (aqui você escolhe os benefícios de acordo com a sua necessidade). ♿

Documentar os processos de instalação e as interações com os clientes no CRM HubSpot. Revisitar os locais para inspeções de manutenção rotineiras e acompanhamentos com os clientes. Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança e dos padrões de instalação da empresa. Requisitos Experiência sólida com instalações e suporte presenciais em ambientes tecnológicos. Conhecimento em sistemas mecânicos e elétricos relevantes para os nossos produtos. Fortes habilidades organizacionais e de gestão do tempo. Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e gerenciar responsabilidades no local com eficiência. Excelentes habilidades interpessoais e aptidão para treinar clientes. Proficiência em documentação técnica e em softwares de CRM. Diferenciais Certificações em elétrica, mecânica ou áreas relacionadas. Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes para instalações e suporte. Fluência em inglês.

Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso. Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Analisar contratos deserviços com foco técnico e financeiro;

title: Analista De Dados
description: A GP Strategies Corporation é um dos principais fornecedores mundiais de transformação de talentos. Ao oferecer soluções premiadas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento, ajudamos as organizações a se transformarem por meio de seu pessoal e a alcançarem mudanças significativas. A GP Strategies forneceu suas soluções inovadoras de consultoria, serviços de aprendizado e tecnologia de talentos para mais de 6.000 organizações em todo o mundo. Com base em nossa experiência global de trabalho em milhares de projetos e iniciativas nos últimos 55 anos, aprendemos que relacionamentos, negócios, trabalho, inovação, estratégia e transformação têm tudo a ver com pessoas. E, em poucas palavras, a GP Strategies é o nosso pessoal: uma extensa rede global de especialistas em aprendizado. Saiba mais em Estamos procurando um Analista de Dados que será responsável por analisar, interpretar e transformar dados relacionados aos programas de treinamento corporativo em insights estratégicos, garantindo a tomada de decisão baseada em dados para otimização de processos, melhoria da experiência do participante e aumento da eficácia dos treinamentos, incluindo a mensuração do retorno sobre investimento. Esquema de trabalho: Remoto. Principais atividades: Coletar, organizar e validar dados provenientes de plataformas de treinamento, LMS (Learning Management System), pesquisas de satisfação e indicadores de desempenho. Desenvolver dashboards e relatórios avançados para monitoramento de KPIs (ex.: taxa de conclusão, engajamento, impacto no negócio). Realizar análises preditivas e prescritivas para identificar tendências, padrões e oportunidades de melhoria nos programas de capacitação. Calcular e analisar o ROI dos programas de treinamento, considerando custos, benefícios tangíveis e intangíveis, e impacto nos resultados do negócio. Apoiar a definição de métricas e indicadores estratégicos para mensuração da eficácia e retorno dos treinamentos. Garantir a qualidade e integridade dos dados, propondo melhorias nos processos de coleta e integração. Utilizar ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) e linguagens de programação (SQL, Python, R) para análises avançadas. Automatizar bases de dados com Power BI e Excel, de forma a otimizar o tempo de resposta Elaborar apresentações executivas com insights claros e recomendações para stakeholders. Requisitos Técnicos: Formação superior em Estatística, Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida em análise de dados, preferencialmente aplicada à área de Treinamentos ou RH. Domínio de ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados. Desejável conhecimento avançado em SQL e linguagens de análise (Python ou R). Experiência com modelagem estatística, análise preditiva e cálculo de ROI. Inglês intermediário ou avançado (desejável). Desejável Facilidade com números e capacidade de defender decisões com embasamento quantitativo. Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de aplicativos simples para suporte a treinamentos (ex.: quizzes e dentre outros) Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial aplicadas à análise de dados e otimização de processos. Com mais de 4.000 funcionários em mais de 30 países, a diversidade na GP Strategies é uma segunda natureza! Além de nossas localidades, nossa cultura se concentra no desempenho e gira em torno do respeito, da justiça e do trabalho colaborativo para atingir nossos objetivos. Apoiamos nossos funcionários, não importa quem sejam ou de onde venham, porque todos nós temos perspectivas e abordagens valiosas e exclusivas. É assim que nascem as grandes ideias, que nos permitem trabalhar de forma mais inteligente. A GP Strategies tem o compromisso e o orgulho de ser um empregador de oportunidades iguais. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para emprego sem levar em conta raça, nacionalidade, gênero, idade, religião, deficiência, orientação sexual, status de veterano ou estado civil.

title: Jovem Aprendiz - Administrativo - São Vicente
description:
O Roldão Atacadista não é apenas uma empresa – é uma história de crescimento e transformação que vem sendo escrita há 25 anos. Tudo começou com a ideia de ser mais do que um atacadista. Nosso objetivo sempre foi ser um parceiro estratégico, abastecendo micros, pequenas e grandes empresas e levando soluções também para as casas dos nossos consumidores finais. Essa trajetória só foi possível porque acreditamos no poder da nossa gente. Somos 4.800 colaboradores que não apenas trabalham aqui – eles constroem o Roldão todos os dias. Por isso, investimos na capacitação de cada um deles, acreditando que um time forte e preparado é o segredo para enfrentar os desafios do mercado e criar inovações que nos destacam. Hoje, com um centro de distribuição e 40 lojas espalhadas pelo estado de São Paulo, vivemos um momento de intensa expansão. E, para crescer, não olhamos apenas para fora, mas também para dentro. Temos o programa DNA de Líderes, com o propósito de formar gestores que inspirem, motivem e transformem. Aqui, os líderes são agentes de mudança, e é com o nosso DNA Roldão – Aqui é o lugar que eles ajudam a nossa gente a alcançar os objetivos mais altos. Essa história é feita por pessoas que acreditam que o trabalho em equipe é o que nos diferencia. Se você sonha em crescer junto, em deixar sua marca em uma empresa que valoriza o esforço e o talento, o Roldão é o lugar certo para você. Junte-se a nós e seja parte de um time que não para de crescer. Roldão Atacadista – Aqui é o lugar! /nEnsino Médio Cursando;
Relacionamentointerpessoal;
Trabalho em equipe. /nO aprendizado ocorrerá através de estágios em cada setor, conforme estipulado no cronograma de atividades assinados pelas partes (Instituição, Roldão e Aprendiz) - Atuará no setor administrativo, organizando documentos e arquivos, entregando relatórios para os chefes de setor, encaminhando malotes, organizando salas para realização de seleção ou treinamentos, realizando levantamento da quantidade de uniformes disponíveis na loja, entregando documentos e notas para assinatura da gerência, separando romaneios (organização por data, setor);
- Atuar no setor de Recursos Humanos, auxiliando na triagem de currículos, organizando e separando os demonstrativos de pagamentos, organizando atestados médicos, convocando candidatos para entrevistas, auxiliando no processo de seleção, realizando entrega de formulários de solicitação de emprego e provas;
- Atuar no setor de frente de caixa, recolhendo mercadorias, efetuando devoluções, atendendo e orientando os clientes da loja;
- Atuar no setor de SAC, atendendo os telefonemas e transferindo para as áreas devidas, realizando chamadas, organizando as notas fiscais e vale trocas;
- Atuar no setor de mercearia, verificando a data de validade das mercadorias, realizando precificação, efetuando reposição de produtos (leves) e higienização das gôndolas;
- Atuar no setor de perecíveis, verificando a data de validade dos produtos, efetuando reposição e pesagem.

title: Agile Developer
description:
Job Description A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Scrum Masters experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe. O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). Duties and Responsibilities: · Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;
· Facilitar cerimôniaságeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;
· Promover o mindset epráticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;
· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;
· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;
· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;
· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;
· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;
· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;
· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);
Minimum Qualifications/Experience: · Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);
· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe · Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade · Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil · Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios · Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade · Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum Minimum Education: · Bachelor's Degree Required Certifications: · Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)Other: · English (plus)

Participar da definição de soluções técnicas a partir de requisitos de negócio, colaborando com produto e clientes. Requisitos: Experiência em Java (8/17 ou superior) e ecossistema Spring (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data). Experiência em front-end: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, jQuery e React. Sólida experiência em APIs REST, autenticação com JWT e integração entre sistemas. Experiência em Hibernate/JPA e bancos SQL (modelagem e otimização). Experiência em AWS (serviços de nuvem), Docker (containers) e Git (versionamento). Metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum. Habilidades: Projetar serviços e aplicações web escaláveis, observáveis e fáceis de manter. Modelar dados e camadas de persistência com foco em desempenho e consistência. Implementar integrações REST seguras e resilientes. Escrever testes unitários e de integração, automatizando rotinas-chave. Documentar soluções e apoiar revisões técnicas (code review). Atitudes: Comunicação clara com time, produto e stakeholders. Colaboração e disponibilidade para discutir alternativas técnicas. Organização e foco em qualidade de entrega. Autonomia, responsabilidade pelo código e melhoria contínua. Adicionais: Graduação completa em TI (ex.: Desenvolvimento de Software, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas). Diferenciais (opcional): Pós-graduação em áreas de tecnologia. Experiência com NoSQL. Experiência em projetos de integração usando OpenAI, Gemini e/ou Copilot. Vivência com assistentes de programação baseadas em IA. Condições da vaga Modelo de contratação: PJ. Modelo de trabalho: Remoto. Venha construir com a Insightful. Se esta oportunidade combina com você, candidate-se e vamos conversar!

Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão: Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.Js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade. Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS. Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos. Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração. Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.O que nós estamos procurando;
Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata. Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.Js, JavaScript e TypeScript. Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance. Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas. Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).O que oferecemos;
VR/VT Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!) Gympass Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!) Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!) Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;
Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

title: Devops Pleno - Gcp
description:

Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor.Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:Contratação: CLTModelo de Trabalho: RemotoHorário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform.Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab, automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD, assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes, monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes, com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD, incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.Experiência com GitLab, aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS, com vivência prática em serviços como EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform, incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.Experiência com scripting e automação, utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.Vivência prática com CI/CD, desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers, incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;

title: Risk Expert
description:
About UsEstablished in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
Net-worth monitoring.Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.Requirements:Legally resident in Brazil.Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
postgraduate qualification preferred.Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
fluency in Portuguese and English.Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

description: A GP Strategies Corporation é um dos principais fornecedores mundiais de transformação de talentos. Desenvolver dashboards e relatórios avançados para monitoramento de KPIs (ex.: taxa de conclusão, engajamento, impacto no negócio). Realizar análises preditivas e prescritivas para identificar tendências, padrões e oportunidades de melhoria nos programas de capacitação. Calcular e analisar o ROI dos programas de treinamento, considerando custos, benefícios tangíveis e intangíveis, e impacto nos resultados do negócio. Apoiar a definição de métricas e indicadores estratégicos para mensuração da eficácia e retorno dos treinamentos. Garantir a qualidade e integridade dos dados, propondo melhorias nos processos de coleta e integração. Utilizar ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) e linguagens de programação (SQL, Python, R) para análises avançadas. Requisitos Técnicos: Formação superior em Estatística, Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida em análise de dados, preferencialmente aplicada à área de Treinamentos ou RH. Domínio de ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados. Desejável conhecimento avançado em SQL e linguagens de análise (Python ou R). Experiência com modelagem estatística, análise preditiva e cálculo de ROI. Inglês intermediário ou avançado (desejável). Desejável Facilidade com números e capacidade de defender decisões com embasamento quantitativo. Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de aplicativos simples para suporte a treinamentos (ex.: quizzes e dentre outros) Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial aplicadas à análise de dados e otimização de processos. Com mais de 4.000 funcionários em mais de 30 países, a diversidade na GP Strategies é uma segunda natureza! Além de nossas localidades, nossa cultura se concentra no desempenho e gira em torno do respeito, da justiça e do trabalho colaborativo para atingir nossos objetivos. Apoiamos nossos funcionários, não importa quem sejam ou de onde venham, porque todos nós temos perspectivas e abordagens valiosas e exclusivas. É assim que nascem as grandes ideias, que nos permitem trabalhar de forma mais inteligente. A GP Strategies tem o compromisso e o orgulho de ser um empregador de oportunidades iguais. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para emprego sem levar em conta raça, nacionalidade, gênero, idade, religião, deficiência, orientação sexual, status de veterano ou estado civil.

contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).- Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers, incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?- Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition


Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.


At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.


We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ. This is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.


What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Financial Cents to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.


What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Financial Cents or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts.
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.


The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.


Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Indirect Tax Manager

We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  1. The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;

  3. Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  4. Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  5. Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  2. Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  3. Knowledge in Tax reform;
  4. Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

- 建立区域人才盘点机制，识别高潜人才，制定并推动关键人才的培养、发展和留任计划。

- 设计与业务目标紧密关联的培训发展体系，提升员工整体能力素质。

- 营造积极、包容、高绩效的企业文化，提升员工敬业度和组织凝聚力。

- 处理复杂的员工关系问题，确保公司在巴西的雇佣实践完全符合当地法律法规。

- 建立有效的内部沟通机制，确保公司价值观和战略在区域内的有效传递。

- 全面负责巴西的人力资源合规性，包括但不限于劳动法、税务、社保等，规避用工风险。

- 及时更新各国劳动法规政策变化，并对业务进行预警和指导。

任职要求

必备条件：

- 本科及以上学历，人力资源、管理学、心理学或相关专业。

- 10年以上人力资源领域工作经验，其中至少5年以上作为区域HR负责人或高级HRBP，全面负责巴西的人力资源管理工作。

-精通葡萄牙语优先，英语能作为工作语言。

- 对拉美巴西的劳动法、雇佣实践、社保体系和商业文化有深入理解和实操经验。

- 具备在高速增长、多变的创业环境中工作的成功经验，能够处理模糊性和复杂性。

- 出色的沟通、影响和协调能力，能够与不同文化背景的各级员工和业务领导者有效合作。

- 卓越的战略思维和解决问题的能力，能够将业务需求转化为具体的人力资源举措。

优先考虑：

- 有在(您所在的行业，如：科技、互联网、制造业等)公司的工作经验。

- 有从0到1搭建区域HR体系的经验。

- 拥有在复杂跨国公司矩阵式组织结构中工作的经验。

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role


This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities


  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results


  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements


  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.

title: Accounting & Administrative Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a highly capable Accountant to support the financial operations of MoveUp across multiple entities.


In this role, you will ensure the smooth running of daily accounting activities, reinforce financial controls, and provide essential backup across all key operational processes.


This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys solving complex operational challenges, and is committed to maintaining high standards of accuracy and reliability in our financial workflows.


Specifically, your role will involve:


Customer Billing & Receivables


  • Create, validate, and issue customer invoices
  • Manage invoicing workflows
  • Monitor incoming payments and perform payment matching
  • Execute customer reminders and maintain updated follow-up tracking
  • Maintain customer reporting and ensure accuracy of receivables data


Supplier Accounting & Payables


  • Verify and validate supplier invoices
  • Ensure correct accounting allocation of supplier expenses
  • Support the monthly payables closing process


Bank Reconciliation & Treasury Support


  • Perform reconciliations for multi-currency accounts
  • Assist with treasury tracking and cash flow updates


General Accounting & Reporting


  • Support the bookkeeping
  • Maintain and control analytical entries
  • Participate in quarterly closings
  • Ensure compliance with internal financial processes


Cross-Entity Support & Process Improvements


  • Contribute to standardizing accounting processes across the group
  • Participate in internal projects workflow optimization, workflow automation, reporting enhancement
  • Improve documentation and build a finance operational manual


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Minimum 3 years of experience in accounting
  • Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations, and financial workflows
  • Experience with Odoo is a plus
  • Solid Excel / Google Sheets skills
  • Ability to work across multiple entities and currencies
  • Strong attention to detail, reliability, and autonomy
  • English required;
    Portuguese or French isa plus
  • Experience with international accounting environments is appreciated


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next Steps in the Process ✅


  1. First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  2. Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  3. Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for You


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

title: Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Credit Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical, organized, and hands-on professional with strong leadership skills to coordinate the areas of Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit . This is a strategic position with a structured career path toward a Finance Manager role within up to 18 months , based on performance.

Key Responsibilities

Treasury

  • Prepare and monitor daily, weekly, and projected cash flow;
  • Manage bank accounts, balances, reconciliations, and financial investments;
  • Plan fund transfers between SPVs (SPEs) and partners;
  • Support Controllership with monthly close and cash flow projections;
  • Ensure banking security, proper segregation of duties, and approval levels.

Accounts Payable

  • Coordinate the full payment cycle (review, approval, and execution);
  • Ensure accurateposting of invoices, tax withholdings, and cost centers;
  • Implement and maintain payment policies;
  • Control due dates for contracts, insurance policies, and recurring expenses;
  • Monitor advances, corporate credit cards, and payment exceptions;
  • Support financial automation initiatives and accounting integration.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Coordinate billing (rent, charges, fees, and services);
  • Monitor delinquency, aging reports, collections, and postings in the ERP;
  • Implement preventive and corrective collection policies;
  • Support negotiations with customers and legal teams when required;
  • Develop management reports by property/project.

Credit

  • Implement and continuously review the company’s credit policy;
  • Perform customer financial and credit analysis;
  • Classify customers according to risk levels;
  • Monitor delinquency indicators and credit performance;
  • Train commercial and operational teams on credit rules and processes.

Management & Strategy

  • Develop financial dashboards and performance indicators;
  • Lead continuousimprovement and automation projects;
  • Act as the financial interface with partners, funds, and investors;
  • Conduct performance evaluations, develop successors, and build future leaders;
  • Act strategically alongside Controllership and Executive Management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or related fields;
  • Solid experience in Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit;
  • Experience working with financial ERP systems;
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills;
  • Leadership profile with autonomy and strategic mindset;
  • English proficiency is a plus (reading and speaking).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the real estate sector;
  • Experience managing financial flows between SPVs (SPEs);
  • Proven experience implementing financial automation.

What We Offer

  • Clear and structured career path toward a Finance Manager position;
  • Strong technical and strategic development environment;
  • Direct exposureto business financial decision-making.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely;
    able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition


Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.


At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.


We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ. This is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.


What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Financial Cents to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.


What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Financial Cents or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts.
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.


The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.


Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Estagiário Fiscal
description:

title: Assistente De Contas A Pagar
description:
Resumo da Função

Buscamos um Analista de Contas a Pagar que eleve o padrão financeiro da Marjom. Alguém rigoroso com detalhes, rápido na execução, dono das entregas e capaz de sustentar um fluxo sólido entre fábrica, fornecedores e diretoria. É uma cadeira estratégica para garantir previsibilidade, controle e saúde financeira.

Responsabilidades

  • Executar todo o fluxo de contas a pagar: conferência, classificação, programação e pagamentos.
  • Validar notas fiscais, boletos, retenções e impostos obrigatórios (ISS, INSS, IR, PIS/COFINS/CSLL).
  • Controlar vencimentos e montar a previsão de pagamentos semanal e mensal.
  • Realizar conciliações bancárias diárias e garantir acuracidade dos saldos.
  • Alimentar e atualizar planilhas e dashboards financeiros, assegurando consistência dos dados.
  • Manter relacionamento claro e profissional com fornecedores, negociando prazos quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar o fluxo de aprovação interna (diretoria, controladoria e demais áreas).
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas com documentação organizada e rastreável.
  • Contribuir para melhorias de processo, automatizações e aumento de eficiência.

Qualificações Técnicas

  • Experiência sólida em contas a pagar, financeiro ou controladoria.
  • Domínio de Excel/Google Sheets (PROCV/XLOOKUP, Tabela Dinâmica, fórmulas de análise).
  • Conhecimento de ERPs — desejável experiência com sistemas de indústria.
  • Entendimento de rotinas fiscais e contábeis.
  • Capacidade de montar previsões de fluxo de caixa e análises de variações.
  • Organização extrema e atenção a detalhes — nada passa despercebido.
  • Visão numérica forte e conforto com grandes volumes de dados.

Competências Interpessoais

  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e madura — sabe explicar problemas e alternativas.
  • Postura de dono: assume, resolve e entrega no prazo.
  • Agilidade e capacidade de priorizar em cenários de pressão.
  • Relacionamento respeitoso e colaborativo com times internos e fornecedores.
  • Disciplina e constância — mantém o ritmo mesmo em semanas críticas.
  • Curiosidade e mentalidade de melhoria contínua.
  • Alta confiabilidade e ética — lida com informações sensíveis diariamente.

Como este cargo se encaixa na Marjom

Esta função sustenta a operação financeira da empresa e é peça-chave para tomada de decisão. O Analista de Contas a Pagar garante previsibilidade, protege caixa, fortalece relações com fornecedores e cria uma base segura para o crescimento da companhia.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely;
    able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Bookkeeper
description:

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role


This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities


  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results


  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements


  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition


Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.


At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.


We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ. This is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.


What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Financial Cents to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.


What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Financial Cents or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts.
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.


The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.


Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Aml/Cft Compliance Expert
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously enhance AML/CFT and sanctions policies in alignment with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Act as a primary compliance interface with regulators, including managing inspections, responding to inquiries, and executing remediation plans.
  • Perform risk-based customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews for both individuals and corporate clients.
  • Support ongoing monitoring activities, including transaction surveillance, sanctions screening, and the investigation of alerts or potentially suspicious behaviors.
  • Prepare, review, and submit Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other mandatory filings to COAF or relevant regulatory bodies.
  • Track legislative and regulatory developments related to AML/CFT and sanctions, and drive timely updates to internal policies and procedures.
  • Assist in delivering internal training programs to strengthen organizational awareness of AML/CFT and sanctions compliance obligations.
  • Conduct periodic AML/CFT risk assessments to validate control effectiveness and ensure alignment with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, audit trails, and recordkeeping for all compliance assessments, escalations, investigations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits as well as regulatory reviews, ensuring timely and accurate provision of information.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to enhance compliance systems, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and oversight of third-party service providers supporting AML/CFT and broader compliance functions.

Requirements

  • Must be legally residing in Brazil.
  • Minimum 7 years of senior-level AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience within financial services, fintech, or virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense , with sound judgment in escalation and decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of COAF, the Central Bank of Brazil, CVM regulations, and FATF recommendations.
  • Hands-on expertise in KYC/KYB processes, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or a related field;
    postgraduate studies orprofessional certifications (CAMS, ICA, etc.) strongly preferred.
  • Excellent analytical abilities, high ethical standards, and full professional fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must satisfy all fit-and-proper requirements, including:
  • No history of bankruptcy or insolvency;
  • An impeccable professional reputation;
  • Strong understanding of the crypto industry, including market dynamics and associated risks;
  • Technical competence aligned with the responsibilities of the role.

title: Assistente De Folha De Pagamento (Dp)
description:

A ContabilizaEcom é uma empresa de contabilidade especialmente voltada para o e‑commerce, que combina expertise fiscal, tributária e empresarial para apoiar lojas online no Brasil.

title: Especialista Fiscal
description:
Nós da Odoo acreditamos que softwares para gerenciar negócios devem cobrir necessidades complexas sem serem complicados. Somos um conjunto de aplicativos de negócios em código aberto que cobre todas as necessidades das pequenas e médias empresas: CRM, e-commerce, contabilidade, estoque… Ajudamos empresas a se tornarem mais eficientes, gastando menos!

Aqui na Odoo, Especialistas Fiscais são pessoas colaborativas, orientadas para resultados, com visão analítica e paixão por tecnologia. São responsáveis por garantir o sucesso da Localização Brasileira no nosso software, implementando seus módulos e atuando em contato direto com os clientes para assegurar a conformidade com as legislações fiscais e tributárias.


Para isso, você será a linha de frente, analisando as necessidades dos clientes, projetando a solução, configurando os fluxos fiscais, e fornecendo sessões de treinamento . Sua atuação é crucial para garantir que os projetos sejam entregues dentro do prazo e do orçamento, além de ser um ponto importante de apoio para o time de P.O. de Localização Brasileira.

Também será responsável por manter atualizada a nossa base de conhecimento dos fluxos de localização brasileira, facilitando a autonomia do cliente após a implementação.


Basicamente, você será responsável por fornecer a melhor solução de gerenciamento fiscal/contábil aos seus clientes, prestando suporte interno com as demandas fiscais e tributárias necessárias para facilitar os negócios dos nossos clientes, apoiando PMEs de diversos setores a extrair o máximo valor da Odoo. Atuamos com foco no usuário, de maneira ágil, dinâmica e sempre pensando no longo prazo.


Responsabilidades e dia a dia:

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes durante a implementação do Odoo.
  • Analisar as necessidades do cliente e os requisitos fiscais e contábeis.
  • Prestar apoio para time interno de Analistas de Negócios e Time Comercial com dúvidas e validações contábeis/fiscais.
  • Garantir que os projetos estão em conformidade com as fundamentações fiscais corretas através da operacionalização no Portal Avalara (será treinado).
  • Atuará com implementação de projetos compreendendo a nova reforma tributária a partir de 2026.
  • Documentar os cenários de validação fiscal dos projetos, gerar relatórios e documentações dos fluxos fiscais para documentação interna e documentação de cliente.
  • Atuar diretamente em contato com o P.O. do produto de Localização Brasileira para apoiar em especificações técnicas e testes de funcionalidades e bugfixes.
