title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely;
    able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role


This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities


  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results


  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements


  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:

You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely;
    able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role


This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities


  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results


  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements


  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

  • 渠道开发与管理：经销商开发与管理，依据经营体发展计划，开发经销商资源并选择符合公司要求的经销商，对经销商营销过程进行指导和管控。
  • 二网开发与管理：推动经销商进行网店开发、运营和培训。
  • 销售运营与提升：策略制定和执行（价格、营销、产品等）：与经销商确认年度销售计划，推动经销商制定营销、产品、价格等策略，并具体签订各类相关商务合同。对市场业务涉及到各项具体推进事项进行检核与反馈。

  • 计划制定与执行：清晰认识整体经营目标，与内外部协同机构有效沟通、联动。

任职资格

  • 5年及以上海外销售工作经验，能适应海外出差。
  • 具有较强的沟通协调能力。
  • 有较强的市场敏锐度、执行力，具有经营思维。

title: Senior Accountant
description:
At MAVI, we connect top finance & accounting professionals with high-impact opportunities at US companies. Whether you’re looking for full-time or part-time projects, our network helps you define your next move.


Joining our invite-only network means:


  • Exposure to projects where your work makes a direct impact
  • Premium compensation compared to market alternatives
  • Opportunities with VC-backed startups & established US firms
  • Growth as part of an elite global community of professionals


Before working with clients, candidates complete our vetting process to join the MAVI network.


About the Role


We’ve partnered with a growing early childhood education provider that operates a nationwide network of child care centers. They are hiring a Senior Accountant to oversee end-to-end accounting operations across 20–30 centers and lead the transition from QuickBooks Online to NetSuite.

This is a high-impact role where you’ll combine hands-on accounting with process improvement, helping the organization scale as it continues to expand its footprint.


What You’ll Do


  • Lead and support the transition from QuickBooks Online to NetSuite (~70% complete), ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency
  • Manage full-cycle accounting operations: general ledger, AP, AR, reconciliations, and month-end close
  • Prepare and analyze financial statements, reports, and supporting schedules
  • Maintain and update loan schedules, insurance allocations, and related entries across operating entities
  • Categorize transactions in Ramp, Brex, and other systems (~1 day/month)
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to management for decision-making
  • Continuously improve accounting processes and leverage NetSuite functionality for efficiency gains
  • Handle other responsibilities typically expected of a Senior Accountant


What We’re Looking For


  • CPA or equivalent preferred
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on accounting experience
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting standards
  • Proficiency in NetSuite
  • Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and transition projects from QBO to NetSuite preferred
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills
  • Ability to operate independently while supporting a multi-entity, growing organization


Why Join Through MAVI?


  • 100% Remote
  • High-impact role supporting a fast-growing education services company
  • Competitive compensation aligned with global opportunities
  • Build your track record within the MAVI network


Selection Process


1️⃣ Initial Interview (20 min) – Meet with Sebastian (Talent Partner) and complete a short accounting exercise

2️⃣ Behavioral Interview (30 min) – Discuss your motivation and fit for working with MAVI clients

Successful candidates join the MAVI Talent Network and gain access to this and future opportunities.


Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion


MAVI provides equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or expression.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role


This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities


  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results


  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements


  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

title: Aml/Cft Compliance Expert
description:

  • Conduct periodic AML/CFT risk assessments to validate control effectiveness and ensure alignment with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, audit trails, and recordkeeping for all compliance assessments, escalations, investigations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits as well as regulatory reviews, ensuring timely and accurate provision of information.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to enhance compliance systems, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and oversight of third-party service providers supporting AML/CFT and broader compliance functions.

Requirements

  • Must be legally residing in Brazil.
  • Minimum 7 years of senior-level AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience within financial services, fintech, or virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense , with sound judgment in escalation and decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of COAF, the Central Bank of Brazil, CVM regulations, and FATF recommendations.

  • An impeccable professional reputation;
  • Strong understanding of the crypto industry, including market dynamics and associated risks;
  • Technical competence aligned with the responsibilities of the role.

title: Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Credit Coordinator

  • Direct exposureto business financial decision-making.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant


Remote – Brazil


*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.


Company Overview


Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.


Position Overview


As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.


Key Responsibilities

  1. Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online;
    identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  2. Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  3. Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules;
    contribute to month-endclose processes.
  4. Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance;
    provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  5. Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  6. Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries;
    maintain supporting documentation.
  7. Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  8. Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules;
    serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  9. Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  1. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  2. Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  3. Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  4. Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  5. Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  6. Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  1. 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  2. Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  3. Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  4. Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  5. Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  6. Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  1. Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  2. Flexible work environment.
  3. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

description:

By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely;
    able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

description:
Missão da Área

A área atua como guardiã da segurança jurídica e financeira, conduzindo o planejamento tributário e oferecendo análises estratégicas que otimizam a carga tributária de forma ética e sustentável.   • Monitorar e interpretar mudanças regulatórias, incluindo TBU (Tributação Base Universal) e diretrizes do Pillar II (BEPS), garantindo aderência às normas internacionais.
  • Atuar como líder técnico na implantação de projetos e na adequação de sistemas e processos internos.

title: Accounting & Administrative Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a highly capable Accountant to support the financial operations of MoveUp across multiple entities.


In this role, you will ensure the smooth running of daily accounting activities, reinforce financial controls, and provide essential backup across all key operational processes.


This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys solving complex operational challenges, and is committed to maintaining high standards of accuracy and reliability in our financial workflows.


Specifically, your role will involve:


Customer Billing & Receivables


  • Create, validate, and issue customer invoices
  • Manage invoicing workflows
  • Monitor incoming payments and perform payment matching
  • Execute customer reminders and maintain updated follow-up tracking
  • Maintain customer reporting and ensure accuracy of receivables data


Supplier Accounting & Payables


  • Verify and validate supplier invoices
  • Ensure correct accounting allocation of supplier expenses
  • Support the monthly payables closing process


Bank Reconciliation & Treasury Support


  • Perform reconciliations for multi-currency accounts
  • Assist with treasury tracking and cash flow updates


General Accounting & Reporting


  • Support the bookkeeping
  • Maintain and control analytical entries
  • Participate in quarterly closings
  • Ensure compliance with internal financial processes


Cross-Entity Support & Process Improvements


  • Contribute to standardizing accounting processes across the group
  • Participate in internal projects workflow optimization, workflow automation, reporting enhancement
  • Improve documentation and build a finance operational manual


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Minimum 3 years of experience in accounting
  • Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations, and financial workflows
  • Experience with Odoo is a plus
  • Solid Excel / Google Sheets skills
  • Ability to work across multiple entities and currencies
  • Strong attention to detail, reliability, and autonomy
  • English required;
    Portuguese or French isa plus
  • Experience with international accounting environments is appreciated


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next Steps in the Process ✅


  1. First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  2. Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  3. Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for You


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

1、销售战略制定：制定并执行国家级销售战略，以支持公司的整体目标。分析市场趋势和竞争动态，识别新的销售机会。领导本地实现业务营收目标；

2、团队管理和辅导：招募、培训和发展销售团队，提升团队绩效和士气。设定销售目标，监控团队绩效并进行定期评估。

5、市场洞察和机会点发掘，产品迭代；

（跨行业漏斗、租房、抢人、内推激励程度）

任职资格

1、35岁以内，本科及以上学历，8年行业销售经验，在国家或国际区域有0-1的销售管理经验，商机敏感度高；

2、结果导向，抗压能力强，学习力强接地气，能够在快节奏环境中工作，适应变化。

3、优秀的沟通、谈判和人际交往能力。具备很好的跨部门协同能力，能够有效整合各项资源推进业务发展。

4、拥有巴西签证，长期base巴西，拥有流利的中文+英语or葡萄牙语言能力。

5、熟悉跨境支付/贸易，有当地相应人脉资源为加分项；

福利待遇

1、具有竞争力的底薪+绩效奖金

2、灵活的工作环境

3、加入跨境支付领域快速发展的领军企业

4、国内培训+轮岗学习+持续培训及职业发展机会

title: Supervisão De Contabilidade
description:
Fundada em 1899, a Sonoco é um fabricante líder de embalagens de consumo, industriais, de cuidados de saúde e de proteção.

As nossas soluções de embalagem integradas ajudam a definir a personalidade das marcas, a criar experiências únicas para os clientes e a melhorar a qualidade dos produtos e a qualidade de vida das pessoas em todo o mundo.

Tudo isto ao serviço do nosso objetivo: Melhores Embalagens. Uma vida melhor.

A Sonoco está empenhada em criar produtos, serviços e programas sustentáveis para os nossos clientes, funcionários e comunidades. A Sonoco foi listada como uma das empresas mais admiradas do mundo pela Fortune em 2021, além de ter sido incluída nas 100 empresas mais sustentáveis da Barron pelo terceiro ano consecutivo.

Saiba mais em Sonoco.Com

Supervisão de Contabilidade

Descrição: O profissional liderará o processo de fechamento de balanço, analisará os resultados financeiros e garantirá que eles estejam apropriados de acordo com a atividade operacional e dentro dos padrões e normas contábeis.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis – Com CRC ativo;
  • Desejável Pós-Graduação/MBA em Controladoria;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.

Responsabilidades do cargo:

  • Liderar o fechamento contábil mensal, trimestral e anual, assegurando processos precisos e realizados dentro dos prazos estabelecidos e aderência às normas locais e internacionais (USGAAP);
  • Coordenar a elaboração e entrega de relatórios locais e corporativos, garantindo exatidão e pontualidade;
  • Assegurar a conformidade com controles internos, políticas e procedimentos corporativos;
  • Preparar e revisar demonstrações financeiras;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e apoiar a implementação de iniciativas de padronização de processos;
  • Supervisionara equipe de Contabilidade, assegurando a conformidade dos controles internos, a correta apuração das contas gerais, reconciliações, ativo fixo, depreciação e das demonstrações financeiras, bem como o cumprimento das obrigações contábeis específicas (arrendamento, receita, receita por contrato, apuração do imposto de renda, envio do ECD e ECF);
  • Coordenar a entrega de informações e suporte para auditorias internas e externas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento técnico e comportamental da equipe, promovendo o crescimento e a retenção de talentos;
  • Apoiar áreas internas como fiscal, financeiro, planejamento financeiro, garantindo consistência de informações e por meio de análises e recomendações voltadas à melhoria contínua dos processos.

A Sonoco valoriza a diversidade e está comprometida em oferecer oportunidades iguais a todas as pessoas, independentemente de raça, etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, nacionalidade, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica pessoal.

title: Cro Specialist

title: Presales Operations Specialist - Remote
description:

Overview of the role:

The Presales Operations Specialist position focuses on serving as the main point of contact for non-commercial tickets in presales, ensuring RFIs and presentations are duly responded to with high content quality. - Owning coordination and submission of Requests for Information (RFIs) by working with subject matter experts to gather content, ensure accuracy, and meet submission deadlines.

- Analytics Skills: Strong capabilities in metrics and reporting.

- Content Creation: Demonstrated experience in content creation, presentations, and sales collaterals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Pessoa Assistente Tributário (Icms) | Atacadão
description:
Maior atacadista brasileiro em número de lojas, o Atacadão está presente em mais de 190 cidades espalhadas por todos os estados do Brasil. GRUPO CARREFOUR BRASIL

- Realizar conciliação fiscal/contábil dos estabelecimentos.

title: Coordenador Fiscal - Torre De Faturamento
description:
Briefing da posição:


Como Coordenador/Supervisor Fiscal da Torre de Faturamento, o profissional será responsável por liderar a operação fiscal vinculada ao faturamento da empresa (“torre” de faturamento), assegurando o correto processamento de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos, cumprimento de obrigações acessórias, e a entrega de resultados por meio de KPIs.


Espera-se perfil de liderança, domínio técnico e capacidade de interface executiva (internamente com Financeiro, Faturamento, Contabilidade, Comercial, e externamente com clientes). O inglês avançado será requisito para interação com equipes globais ou clientes internacionais.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Coordenar as atividades da torre de faturamento: emissão e conferência de notas fiscais (saídas/entradas), conferência de faturamento, retenções, XML, NFS-e/NF-e, CTe, etc.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de obrigações acessórias: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, DCTF, EFD-Contribuições, REINF, ECF/ECD, etc;
  • Implantar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da operação fiscal/faturamento (por exemplo: % de notas com erro fiscal, tempo de processamento, custo por nota, índice de credits fiscais aproveitados, SLA de faturamento, conformidade) e reportar à liderança executiva;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a equipe da torre (coordenados e analistas), promovendo treinamento, engajamento, definição de metas, monitoramento de performance e melhorias contínuas de processo;
  • Interface com Financeiro, Contabilidade, Comercial/Vendas, TI/ERP e auditoria, assegurando que as operações de faturamento estejam alinhadas aos controles internos, aos requisitos de compliance e às estratégias de negócio;
  • Liderar ou participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação, mapeamento de riscos fiscais, aproveitamento de créditos, e adaptação a mudanças da legislação (como reforma tributária, por exemplo) ou cenários de negócio;
  • Apresentar análises gerenciais e relatórios executivos (em inglês, quando for o caso) à alta direção ou matriz, com propostas de ação, acompanhamento de metas e suportes decisórios.


Qualificações & requisitos:


  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Preferencialmente com registro CRC ativo (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência sólida em operação fiscal/tributária, com apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos em ambiente corporativo;
  • Experiência comprovada em faturamento ou faturamento tributário (emissão de notas fiscais, retenções, faturamento em operação com produtos/serviços) e liderança de equipe;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) – para reportes, interface com clientes estrangeiros;
  • Perfil forte deliderança, com habilidades executivas — comunicação clara, capacidade de influenciar, visibilidade junto à diretoria, visão de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com KPIs, dashboards, relatórios gerenciais, e métricas de performance da área fiscal/faturamento;
  • Atuação em ambiente de alta demanda, com foco em prazos, entregas, auditorias e mudanças regulatórias;


Competências comportamentais:


  • Visão estratégica com mindset operacional (“hands-on”);
  • Alta capacidadeanalítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Orientação pararesultados e melhoria contínua;
  • Excelente comunicação (com a equipe, stakeholders e diretoria);
  • Adaptabilidade e proatividade para lidar com mudanças rápidas (ex: reforma tributária, nova legislação);
  • Integridade, postura ética e foco em compliance;


Se você é um líder fiscal com visão estratégica, domínio técnico e capacidade de transformar operações através de performance, governança e indicadores, esta posição pode ser a oportunidade ideal para direcionar resultados com impacto direto no negócio.

title: Especialista De Auditorias Internas
description:
VIVEO - Cuidar de cada vida, simples assim!


Fundados em 1996, somos líderes na fabricação e na distribuição de materiais e medicamentos para o segmento da saúde, com produtos e soluções para todo o Brasil. Com capital 100% nacional, com mais de 50 unidades operacionais e centros de distribuição em todas as regiões do país, temos nossa própria frota e contamos com mais de 6.500 colaboradores diretos.


Com o propósito de cuidar de cada vida, somos a única empresa do Brasil que atua de forma completa no mercado da saúde. Essa atuação reforça nosso compromisso em oferecer soluções confiáveis, ágeis e inovadoras ao setor – incluindo fabricação, distribuição, gestão de estoque, transporte e soluções personalizadas aos hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, farmácias, atacados, indústrias farmacêuticas e aos pacientes finais. Buscamos encontrar e viabilizar as inovações que definirão como cuidar das pessoas do amanhã.


Atividades:

  • Participar na elaboração do Plano Anual de Auditoria Interna (PAINT);
  • Planejar e executar auditorias de alta e média complexidade;
  • Avaliar a eficácia dos Controles Internos e programas de Compliance;
  • Produzir relatórios técnicos e executivos com recomendações realistas e baseadas em boas práticas;
  • Conduzir análises de dados e testes automatizados;
  • Atuar como mentor técnico para a equipe de auditores seniores, plenos e juniores;
  • Apoiar, quando necessário, investigações internas.


Requisitos:

  • Superior completo (bacharel) com pós graduação;
  • Vivência com normas do IIA (IPPF), COSO ERM, ISO 31000;
  • Desejável conhecimento em ACL, Power BI, ERP Protheus;
  • Vivência em Big4 e/ou distribuidoras será um diferencial.

title: Assistente De Negócios - Finanças E Custos

Diferencial

title: Coordenador Contas Me
description:
Prazer, somos a Claro!

title: Accounts Receivable (Ar) Engineer
description:
Sobre nós

Quer fazer parte de uma empresa que está mudando o futuro do mercado imobiliário com inteligência artificial?

Somos a Lastro, uma startup brasileira em crescimento acelerado e criadora da Lais – a IA mais avançada do setor imobiliário. Estamos ao lado de imobiliárias para transformar o atendimento, aumentar a eficiência e gerar dados estratégicos que impulsionam negócios.

Nossa visão é liderar a transformação do mercado imobiliário brasileiro por meio da inteligência artificial — e você está convidado a construir isso com a gente.

Sobre esta vaga

Nossa missão como time de Finance é atuar como guardião dos dados operacionais da Lastro, assegurando a conformidade legal, contábil e fiscal, estruturando a base estratégica para decisões data-driven e fortalecendo a solidez e a evolução da Lastro como ativo.

Além disso, AI traz novos desafios quando falamos de AR. Agora o valor gerado para o cliente é extremamente variável com o volume de utilização, e os custos seguem na mesma linha. Com a Lastro liderando a transformação de AI no mercado imobiliário brasileiro, temos o desafio de equilibrar a previsibilidade que o setor exige, mas com a precificação variável para a captura do valor volátil que o contexto de AI exige.

Com essas condições de contorno, AR tem as funções de:

  1. Atuar como ponto focal acerca das nossas regras do negócio de faturamento, sendo responsável por garantir o alinhamento entre os times de Finance, GTM e Produto;
  2. Operacionalizar o faturamento, desde o fechamento dos números até o envio das faturas e realização das cobranças;
  3. Gerir a carteira de recebíveis e as políticas de cobrança, passando pela otimização das réguas, cobrança ativa, retificação de cobranças ou até pela construção da política de cobrança em uma atuação a seis mãos com os times de GTM e de Produto;
  4. Gerir a complexidade da nossa precificação, garantindo tabulações consistentes e razoáveis para todos os parâmetros do faturamento, e garantindo o espelho disso nas análises, acompanhamentos e monitoramentos de forma consistente.

Seu dia a a dia consistirá em alternar entre essas três principais streams de trabalho sempre garantindo tracking da operação como um todo. Isso será feito desde: trabalhando com stakeholders chave de GTM e de Produto para garantir o alinhamento acerca das nossas regras de negócio;
gerindo dados, processando-os, tratando-os, além de operando e evoluindo nossos sistemas;
e cobrança, interagindoe dialogando com os clientes e com stakeholders de GTM e de Produto de modo a maximizar retenção mantendo o valor e a percepção dele acerca dos produtos que vendemos.

Suas principais entregas:

  • Consolidação do faturamento mensal dentro do SLA;
  • Gestão da carteira de recebíveis e das políticas de cobrança;
  • Melhoria contínua e gestão do processo de faturamento;
  • Tracking da operação de GTM, incluindo tabelas de precificação, pacotes, descontos comerciais, descontos de retenção, retenção, expansão, entre outros;
  • Manutenção das análises do faturamento, visando acuracidade, velocidade, disponibilidade e consistência;
  • Garantia de alinhamento entre Finance, GTM e Produto acerca das nossas regras de negócio e políticas de cobrança;
  • Apoio ativo ao time de Produto no projeto de produtização do faturamento e integração no produto core.

Perfil que buscamos:

  • Perfil fortemente analítico, com foco e experiência prévia com dados e com melhoria de processos;
  • Excelente capacidade e experiência prévia com manipulação de dados e regras de negócio, desde em Google Sheets à em SQL;
  • Excel/Google Sheets avançado;
  • SQL intermediário;
  • Boa capacidade e experiência prévia com alguma posição com relacionamento/interface com clientes externos e internos;
  • Elevado nívelde attention-to-detail;
  • Alto nível deproatividade e autonomia comprovados em contextos complexos e ambíguos;
  • Metódico, comboa capacidade de seguir processos repetitivos e complexos com consistência;
  • Autônomo, self-paced.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com contas a receber ou com a utilização de software ERP;
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente (B2B);
  • Experiência prévia com precificação variável de SaaS, ou em AI SaaS;
  • Experiência prévia como stakeholder de Produto.

Benefícios:

  • Cartão Caju , com mais liberdade para usar seus benefícios.
  • ♀️ Wellhub, extensivo a dependentes legais.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition


Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.


At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.


We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ. This is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.


What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Financial Cents to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.


What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Financial Cents or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts.
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.


The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.


Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Billing Specialist
description:
As a Billing Specialist, you will be crucial to our company's financial management, serving as a vital link between various departments and ensuring accuracy in our billing processes.


Detailed Responsibilities

Customer Billing Management:

  • Collect and verify billing information from multiple internal sources.
  • Generate accurate and detailed invoices using our ERP system.
  • Ensure all invoices comply with legal and tax requirements.
  • Manage billing discrepancies.

Vendor Invoice Processing:

  • Receive and process vendor invoices related to specific projects.
  • Verify invoice accuracy against purchase orders and contracts.
  • Request vendor payments according to agreed terms.

Project Tracking and Reporting:

  • Maintain up-to-date records of each project's financial status.
  • Generate monthly reports on billing progress by project.
  • Collaborate with controlling department to resolve financial discrepancies.

Monthly Closing and Reporting:

  • Prepare and reconcile accounts for monthly closing.
  • Generate detailed financial reports for management review.
  • Assist in preparing presentations for monthly closing meetings.
  • Analyze trends and propose improvements in billing processes.

Data and Systems Management:

  • Maintain accurate customer databases.
  • Continuously update and improve billing processes in the ERP system.
  • Ensure the integrity and confidentiality of financial data.
  • Propose and implement improvements to billing systems.

Interdepartmental Collaboration:

  • Work closely with the sales team to ensure timely billing.
  • Coordinate with the legal department to ensure contractual compliance.
  • Support the controlling team in financial analyses and internal audits.
  • Assist the customer service department with billing-related inquiries.

Professional Development and Continuous Improvement:

  • Stay updated on best practices in billing and finance.
  • Contribute ideas for process improvement and operational efficiency.
  • Mentor new team members as needed.

Profile Requirement

  • Proficiency in billing software and Microsoft Excel is a plus.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Exceptional organizational and time management skills.
  • Effective problem-solving abilities and a professional approach to handling customer inquiries and issues.
  • Knowledge of accounting principles and practices is advantageous.


What we offer

  • An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities
  • An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities
  • A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250+ available modules
  • A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.)

title: Senior Accountant
description:
At MAVI, we connect top finance & accounting professionals with high-impact opportunities at US companies. Whether you’re looking for full-time or part-time projects, our network helps you define your next move.


Joining our invite-only network means:


  • Exposure to projects where your work makes a direct impact
  • Premium compensation compared to market alternatives
  • Opportunities with VC-backed startups & established US firms
  • Growth as part of an elite global community of professionals


Before working with clients, candidates complete our vetting process to join the MAVI network.


About the Role


We’ve partnered with a growing early childhood education provider that operates a nationwide network of child care centers. They are hiring a Senior Accountant to oversee end-to-end accounting operations across 20–30 centers and lead the transition from QuickBooks Online to NetSuite.

This is a high-impact role where you’ll combine hands-on accounting with process improvement, helping the organization scale as it continues to expand its footprint.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage full-cycle accounting operations: general ledger, AP, AR, reconciliations, and month-end close
  • Prepare and analyze financial statements, reports, and supporting schedules
  • Maintain and update loan schedules, insurance allocations, and related entries across operating entities
  • Categorize transactions in Ramp, Brex, and other systems (~1 day/month)
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to management for decision-making
  • Continuously improve accounting processes and leverage NetSuite functionality for efficiency gains
  • Handle other responsibilities typically expected of a Senior Accountant

  • CPA or equivalent preferred
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on accounting experience
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting standards
  • Proficiency in NetSuite
  • Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and transition projects from QBO to NetSuite preferred
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills
  • Ability to operate independently while supporting a multi-entity, growing organization


Why Join Through MAVI?


  • 100% Remote
  • High-impact role supporting a fast-growing education services company
  • Competitive compensation aligned with global opportunities
  • Build your track record within the MAVI network


Selection Process

Successful candidates join the MAVI Talent Network and gain access to this and future opportunities.

MAVI provides equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or expression.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely;
    able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Credit Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical, organized, and hands-on professional with strong leadership skills to coordinate the areas of Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit . This is a strategic position with a structured career path toward a Finance Manager role within up to 18 months , based on performance.

Key Responsibilities

Treasury

  • Prepare and monitor daily, weekly, and projected cash flow;
  • Manage bank accounts, balances, reconciliations, and financial investments;
  • Plan fund transfers between SPVs (SPEs) and partners;
  • Support Controllership with monthly close and cash flow projections;
  • Ensure banking security, proper segregation of duties, and approval levels.

Accounts Payable

  • Coordinate the full payment cycle (review, approval, and execution);
  • Ensure accurateposting of invoices, tax withholdings, and cost centers;
  • Implement and maintain payment policies;
  • Control due dates for contracts, insurance policies, and recurring expenses;
  • Monitor advances, corporate credit cards, and payment exceptions;
  • Support financial automation initiatives and accounting integration.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Coordinate billing (rent, charges, fees, and services);
  • Monitor delinquency, aging reports, collections, and postings in the ERP;
  • Implement preventive and corrective collection policies;
  • Support negotiations with customers and legal teams when required;
  • Develop management reports by property/project.

Credit

  • Implement and continuously review the company’s credit policy;
  • Perform customer financial and credit analysis;
  • Classify customers according to risk levels;
  • Monitor delinquency indicators and credit performance;
  • Train commercial and operational teams on credit rules and processes.

Management & Strategy

  • Develop financial dashboards and performance indicators;
  • Lead continuousimprovement and automation projects;
  • Act as the financial interface with partners, funds, and investors;
  • Conduct performance evaluations, develop successors, and build future leaders;
  • Act strategically alongside Controllership and Executive Management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or related fields;
  • Solid experience in Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit;
  • Experience working with financial ERP systems;
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills;
  • Leadership profile with autonomy and strategic mindset;
  • English proficiency is a plus (reading and speaking).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the real estate sector;
  • Experience managing financial flows between SPVs (SPEs);
  • Proven experience implementing financial automation.

What We Offer

  • Clear and structured career path toward a Finance Manager position;
  • Strong technical and strategic development environment;
  • Direct exposureto business financial decision-making.

description:

Sobre a Sementes Tormenta

A Sementes Tormenta é uma empresa dedicada à produção e comercialização de sementes de alta qualidade e alta performance, comprometida com a excelência e a sustentabilidade no agronegócio. Atuamos com foco em inovação e no atendimento às necessidades dos nossos clientes, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento da agricultura.


Descrição da Vaga

Estamos buscando um(a) Gerente Administrativo altamente estratégico(a) para ser o pilar de eficiência operacional na Sementes Tormenta. O profissional será fundamental para garantir a alta performance e a sustentabilidade dos nossos processos no agronegócio , traduzindo a excelência das nossas sementes em resultados administrativos.


Seus desafios

  • Liderar, motivar e orientar a equipe administrativa.
  • Participar do planejamento, seleção, acompanhamento e desenvolvimento dos colaboradores.
  • Assegurar boas relações e condições de trabalho.
  • Planejar, organizar e controlar as atividades das áreas administrativas.
  • Definir normas e procedimentos a serem seguidos.
  • Otimizar processos para reduzir custos e aumentar a produtividade.
  • Gerenciar o orçamento mensal do setor, controlando custos e despesas operacionais.
  • Elaborar relatórios e indicadores.
  • Assessorar a diretoria na tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  • Definir e gerenciar estratégias que alinhem as operações administrativas aos objetivos da organização.
  • Acompanhar resultados e o desempenho das atividades (monitoramento de KPIs).
  • Garantir a conformidade com leis e regulamentações (Compliance).
  • Garantir a comunicação eficaz entre diferentes departamentos.
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios gerenciais para a direção.
  • Relacionar-se com fornecedores, parceiros e clientes em questões administrativas.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em administração de empresas, contabilidade ou áreas correlacionadas;
  • Experiência comprovada como gerente administrativo em grandes empresas;
  • Pacote Office;
  • Experiência na utilização de SAP;
  • Habilidade paraplanejar, otimizar e monitorar processos internos e projetos administrativos.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar relatórios, indicadores e informações para a tomada de decisões.
  • Entendimento das leis trabalhistas, tributárias e regulamentações pertinentes à operação da empresa (Compliance).
  • Proficiência no uso de sistemas de gestão (ERPs), planilhas avançadas e ferramentas de Business Intelligence (BI).
  • Habilidade para inspirar, motivar e orientar equipes, delegando tarefas e gerenciando conflitos.
  • Transmitir informações de forma clara, objetiva e persuasiva, tanto verbalmente quanto por escrito.
  • Capacidade de enxergar o panorama geral da empresa e alinhar as operações administrativas aos objetivos de longo prazo.
  • Habilidade para priorizar o trabalho, gerenciar o tempo e os recursos de forma eficiente.
  • Agilidade para identificar problemas complexos e implementar soluções eficazes, muitas vezes sob pressão.


Remuneração e Benefícios:

  • Remuneração: Contrato Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) – Remuneração a Combinar;
  • Bonificação Semestral: Incentivo por performance semestral de até 1,5 salários vinculada ao atingimento de metas e KPIs do setor.
  • Bolsa de Estudos: conforme política interna de concessão.
  • Trabalho presencial em Catanduvas-PR.


Faça parte da Sementes Tormenta e contribua para o crescimento da agricultura com qualidade e dedicação!

Sementes Tormenta: Nosso maior compromisso é a qualidade.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.

title: Assistente Administrativo
description:
Sobre a Empresa

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up , o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Desafio:


Será responsável pela organização física e digital de todos os documentos da área (contratos, notas fiscais, relatórios, atas, correspondências), garantindo a rastreabilidade e o fácil acesso às informações;

Qualificações
