title: Chefe De Oficina
description:
Missão do Cargo


Garantir a disponibilidade, segurança e confiabilidade dos veículos e equipamentos, por meio da gestão eficiente da oficina, controle de manutenção preventiva e corretiva, liderança da equipe técnica e rigor no controle de custos, prazos e qualidade dos serviços executados.



Principais Responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar a rotina da oficina mecânica , organizando serviços de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e emergencial;
  • Planejar e acompanhar o cronograma de manutenções da frota, assegurando disponibilidade operacional dos veículos;
  • Liderar, orientar e avaliar a equipe de mecânicos, auxiliares e terceiros ;
  • Diagnosticar falhas mecânicas, elétricas e estruturais, definindo planos de correção eficientes ;
  • Controlar o uso de peças, materiais, ferramentas e EPIs , evitando desperdícios;
  • Acompanhar e negociar serviços com fornecedores e oficinas terceirizadas ;
  • Realizar controle de custos de manutenção , apontando desvios e oportunidades de redução;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança, meio ambiente e boas práticas mecânicas ;
  • Validar serviços executados, garantindo qualidade, segurança e padronização ;
  • Manter registros, relatórios e indicadores de manutenção (MTBF, MTTR, custo por km, índice de falhas );
  • Atuar em conjunto com a logística e operações para minimizar tempo de veículo parado .



Requisitos Técnicos


  • Experiência comprovada como Chefe de Oficina, Encarregado de Manutenção ou Supervisor Mecânico ;
  • Forte conhecimento em mecânica diesel , elétrica automotiva e manutenção pesada;
  • Vivência com frotas de caminhões, máquinas ou veículos utilitários ;
  • Capacidade de leitura de diagnósticos, laudos técnicos e ordens de serviço;
  • Conhecimento básico ou intermediário em controle de custos e indicadores ;
  • Desejável experiência com sistemas de manutenção (CMMS ou planilhas).



Requisitos Comportamentais


  • Perfil mão na massa , organizado e extremamente responsável;
  • Liderança firme, com autoridade técnica e capacidade de cobrança;
  • Boa comunicaçãocom equipe operacional e gestão;
  • Tomada de decisão rápida em situações críticas;
  • Compromisso comsegurança, qualidade e resultado.



Formação Desejável


  • Curso técnico em Mecânica, Mecânica Automotiva ou Manutenção Diesel ;
  • Cursos de especialização em manutenção pesada ou gestão de frota serão um diferencial.



Indicadores de Desempenho (KPIs)


  • Disponibilidade da frota (%);
  • Custo de manutenção por km;
  • Tempo médio de parada de veículos;
  • Índice de retrabalho;
  • Cumprimento do plano de manutenção preventiva.



Jornada de Trabalho


  • Horário: das 06h00 às 15h00
  • Escala: de segunda a sábado
  • Intervalo: conforme legislação vigente
  • Horas extras: pagas conforme legislação trabalhista, quando houver necessidade operacional



Remuneração e Benefícios


  • Salário: compatível com a função
  • Vale-transporte
  • Vale-alimentação
  • Pagamento de horas extras , conforme legislação



Regime de Contratação


  • CLT

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Company Description


C17 Lab is a revenue engineering firm dedicated to helping B2B organizations address capability and capacity challenges across go-to-market and revenue operations. We specialize in building outbound-led growth systems that turn buying intent into scalable revenue through data-driven processes and accountability. Collaborating with clients ranging from startups to enterprises, we focus on creating financially sustainable growth while exceeding pipeline and revenue goals. Our team offers hands-on support across the full revenue cycle, including go-to-market strategies, demand generation, pipeline management, and revenue operations with CRM integration and reporting.


Role Description


This is a full-time remote role for an Executive Assistant. The Executive Assistant will handle a range of administrative duties, including executive support, managing expense reports, scheduling meetings, organizing calendars, and providing general administrative assistance. The role requires a high level of communication and organizational skills, as well as the ability to manage confidential information and prioritize competing tasks to support executive leadership effectively.


Qualifications


  • Proficiency in Executive Administrative Assistance and Administrative Assistance, with the ability to manage calendars, scheduling, and office operations.
  • 4-10 years of experience as Executive Assistant.
  • Complete fluency in English, both spoken and written.
  • Experience in Expense Reports and related financial administrative tasks.
  • Strong skills in Executive Support, ensuring seamless assistance for senior leaders in daily operations.
  • Excellent Communication skills, including written and verbal communication, with attention to detail.
  • High level of organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities.
  • Proficiency with office productivity tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Claude/ChatGPT
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a remote environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience is a plus.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  1. The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely;
    able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role


This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities


  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results


  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements


  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

description:

  • Remittance of Brazilian employee payroll deposits and monthly FGTS/INSS payroll tax payments.
  • Ability to understand union agreement(s) and serve as a point of contact for employee and/or vendor questions in relation.
  • Knowledge of Brazil payroll tax compliance to ensure the accuracy of system settings and processed transactions.
  • Help to ensure payroll-related tax account registrations are completed as needed.
  • Work closely with our internal accounting department to provide support on payroll-related questions or documentation as needed.
  • Own data collection, entries, and accuracy across multiple systems that impact global payroll operations.
  • Assist employees with inquiries related to payroll matters.
  • Assist with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end payroll processes and related tax reconciliations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with business partners (People/Benefits/Finance) for process improvements and efficiencies.
  • Create and/or maintain payroll documentation as it relates to processing, operational procedures, compliance, and other payroll-related matters.
  • Assist in ad-hoc duties when required (ie. audits, payroll backup for other entities, external payment operations, etc.)



Skills/Qualifications Required:



  • Minimum of 2-4 years of payroll processing.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with team members and other stakeholders.
  • Exposure to a SOX-regulated environment is preferred but not required.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and proven to have excellent time management skills to deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational skills;
    ability to meet deadlines across multiple tasks.
  • Recent processing experience with Deel or other third-party payroll providers. Exposure to ADP Workforce Now, HiBob, Slack, Jira, and Jibble preferred.
  • Knowledge of Sao Paulo Union agreements and Brazilian labor laws;

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition


Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.


At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.


We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ. This is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.


What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Financial Cents to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.


What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Financial Cents or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts.
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.


The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.


Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

  4. Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance;
    provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  5. Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  6. Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries;
    maintain supporting documentation.
  7. Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  8. Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules;
    serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  9. Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  1. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  2. Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  3. Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  4. Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  5. Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  6. Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  1. 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  2. Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  3. Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  4. Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  5. Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  6. Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  1. Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  2. Flexible work environment.
  3. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  1. The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  2. Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  3. Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  4. Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  5. Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  2. Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  3. Knowledge in Tax reform;
  4. Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Assistente De Crédito E Cobrança
description:
Sobre a empresa:

Com uma história sólida de sucesso desde sua fundação em 1967, a Verzani & Sandrini se destaca em todo território nacional em diversos serviços terceirizados.

Presente em todo o Brasil com mais de 70 mil colaboradores, atendemos setores como shopping centers, indústrias, hospitais, aeroportos e mais. Oferecemos soluções que vão desde facilities até segurança patrimonial, segurança eletrônica e manutenção. Unimos tecnologia, inovação e capacitação profissional para fornecer soluções de alta qualidade e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Descrição da posição:

O Assistente de Crédito e Cobrança é responsável por apoiar os processos de análise de crédito, acompanhamento da carteira de recebíveis e execução das atividades de cobrança, garantindo a conformidade das informações, a redução da inadimplência e o cumprimento das políticas internas da empresa. Atua de forma direta com clientes, áreas financeiras e equipe comercial para assegurar a eficiência no fluxo de recebimentos.

Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar análises iniciais de crédito, avaliando documentos, limites e histórico de clientes conforme políticas internas.
  • Acompanhar diariamente a carteira de clientes, monitorando vencimentos, pagamentos e indicadores de inadimplência.
  • Executar ações de cobrança (ativa e receptiva), negociando prazos, valores e acordos quando necessário.
  • Atualizar controles financeiros, relatórios de inadimplência e registros de cobrança em sistemas e planilhas.
  • Emitir boletos, duplicatas, extratos e demais documentos relacionados a recebimentos.
  • Realizar baixa de títulos pagos e conciliação básica de recebimentos.
  • Apoiar a equipe na revisão e atualização de limites de crédito.
  • Manter comunicação clara e profissional com clientes e áreas internas, garantindo a solução de pendências.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de cobrança e análise de crédito.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo (desejável técnico ou superior em Administração, Contabilidade, Gestão Financeira ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência prévia em cobrança, contas a receber ou análise de crédito.
  • Conhecimento básico de rotinas financeiras e conciliações.
  • Domínio de Excel e sistemas de gestão (ERP/CRM).
  • Boa comunicação, organização e habilidade para lidar com negociações.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Foco em resultados e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Capacidade de negociação e persuasão.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e precisão nas informações.
  • Proatividade e senso de urgência.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal e postura profissional.

Benefícios da Vaga

title: Coordenador De Crédito E Cobrança - Regional Sul
description:
RAINBOW DEFENSIVOS AGRÍCOLAS

Tudo sobre crescimento.



Somos uma empresa líder em proteção de cultivos que produz, distribui e comercializa Defensivos Agrícolas.

Somos a maior exportadora de agroquímicos da China e TOP10 indústria agroquímica global, presente em mais de 100 países nos 5 continentes, com 6 fábricas próprias e um time de especialistas focados em solucionar as necessidades dos clientes.


Estamos em expansão no Brasil e buscamos profissionais comprometidos e que enxerguem na expansão uma oportunidade de construir e transformar.


Se você quer atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e contribuir para transformar o futuro da proteção de cultivos no país, venha fazer parte da Rainbow Defensivos Agrícolas.



  • Coordenador de Crédito e Cobrança - Regional Sul


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:


  • Liderar equipe regional de Representantes de Crédito e Cobrança de Campo.
  • Responsável pela análise de risco, concessão de crédito e cobrança em clientes do mercado agro (revendas, distribuidores, cooperativas e produtores rurais) nas regiões Sul, Sudeste e Cerrado.
  • Planejar e acompanhar visitas de campo, suportar o time comercial em negociações, garantir a formalização de garantias (CPR, cessão de crédito, penhor de grãos, seguro de crédito, fiança etc.).
  • Monitorar indicadores de inadimplência e qualidade da carteira.
  • Conduzir renegociações e atuar em conjunto com jurídico e áreas internas para reduzir perdas e apoiar o crescimento sustentável das vendas.


REQUISITOS:


  • Graduação em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Agronegócio, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
    experiência sólida em crédito e cobrança B2B e B2C no agronegócio ou indústria química;
  • Vivência com visitas de campo e negociações com revendas, distribuidores, cooperativas e produtores rurais;
    experiência prévia em liderança de equipe (coordenação/supervisão);
  • Conhecimento deanálise de demonstrações financeiras, políticas de crédito e garantias típicas do agro (CPR, penhor, seguro de crédito, cessão de recebíveis, fiança);
  • Domínio de Excel e sistemas ERP (diferencial SAP);
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes;
  • Residir no Paraná ou Rio Grande do Sul.

title: Tax Manager
description:
Responsibilities:

  1. Conduct financial business management for the Brazilian branch company, overseeing compliance with fiscal laws and regulations, departmental rules, and company policies.
  2. Tax Support: Assist the group in establishing the Brazilian tax framework, control key tax aspects during the setup, and be responsible for various tax-related tasks.
  3. Tax Compliance Management: Proficiently master the Brazilian tax system and knowledge, understand the application of various taxes and rates in the import process of raw materials and equipment, establish the tax framework for the daily operations of the Brazilian company, and ensure the business system complies with Brazilian tax requirements.
  4. Familiarize with Brazilian tax incentive policies, assist the company in local tax planning, fully leverage local policies, and reduce the company's tax burden.
  5. Responsible for assessing local tax risks in Brazil, providing professional guidance on major tax-related matters, and identifying potential risk points in advance.
  6. Transfer Pricing Management: Responsible for tracking the formulation and implementation of transfer pricing policies for the company, as well as preparing and submitting transfer pricing documentation.
  7. External Relationship Maintenance: Liaise with local tax firms, actively respond to daily tax inquiries and inspections from Brazilian tax authorities and other government agencies.
  8. External Policy Response: Keep track of changes in tax policies, interpret them in a timely manner, and proactively address local tax reforms in Brazil.
  9. Perform other tasks assigned by the headquarters department.


Qualifications:

  1. Experience in the manufacturing industry, with preference given to the tire industry;
  2. Major: Accounting, Financial Management, or other related finance disciplines;
  3. Bachelor’s degree or higher;
  4. Over 10 years of financial management experience;
    familiar with management systems of listed companies, extensive tax experience, and more than 5 years of tax-related work experience in Brazil;
  5. Proficient in English and Portuguese.

title: Fiscal De Contrato De Inspeção De Tubos E Hastes
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Fiscal de Contrato de Inspeção de Tubos e Hastes para atuar com um de nossos clientes.

Esse profissional irá garantir o cumprimento técnico, operacional e contratual dos serviços de limpeza, inspeção, recuperação e preservação de tubos e hastes de bombeio realizados pela empresa contratada, assegurando que os trabalhos estejam em conformidade com as normas API, ABNT, ASME e com os procedimentos internos da Empresa

Local de Atuação

  • Presencial nas bases de inspeção em Alto do Rodrigues/RN , Catu/BA ou outras designadas
  • Eventuais deslocamentos para acompanhamento de serviços externos (bases de campo, transporte, armazenagem ou auditorias).

Formação e Experiência

  • Formação mínima: Técnico em Mecânica, Metalurgia, Petróleo ou área correlata (reconhecido pelo MEC).
  • Desejável: CREA ativo e curso de inspetor de equipamentos (ABENDI, SNQC ou equivalente).
  • Experiência:
  • Inspeção ou supervisão de serviços de integridade de tubos e hastes conforme API 5CT, API 11B, API 5B, RP7G-2;
  • Conhecimento prático em processos de usinagem, hidrojateamento, ensaios não destrutivos (EMI, partículas magnéticas, ultrassom), e critérios de classificação API.
  • Diferenciais: vivência em auditorias de fornecedores, leitura de relatórios técnicos e domínio de MS Excel/Word/Power BI.

Atividades

  1. Garantir que todos os equipamentos de inspeção tenham certificados de calibração válidos e rastreáveis ao INMETRO .
  2. Avaliar os procedimentos operacionais da contratada e reportar não conformidades.
  3. Monitorar a execução dos serviços de hidrojateamento, usinagem e preservação.
  4. Assegurar a correta aplicação de critérios API (aceitação, rejeição e classificação).
  5. Fiscalizar o uso de EPIs conforme NR-06 e as normas de segurança da Empresa
  6. Garantir limpeza e segregação das áreas de trabalho, descarte de resíduos e controle de produtos químicos.
  7. Emitir relatórios de acompanhamento técnico semanal
  8. Registrar e validar estatísticas de reprovação, causas e recomendações.
  9. Participar das reuniões de performance e auditorias internas/externas.
  10. Interagir com a fiscalização da Empresa, setor de manutenção e operação de poços.
  11. Apoiar o alinhamento de critérios técnicos entre Bahia e RN.
  12. Participar de revisões de procedimento, reclassificação e auditorias da contratada.

title: Assistente De Operações
description:
Assistente de Operações

O Assistente de Operações é responsável por apoiar a execução das atividades operacionais em campo e garantir que os processos, rotinas e ações do projeto aconteçam com fluidez, qualidade e alinhamento às metas estabelecidas. É um cargo que atua como ponte entre a coordenação do projeto, as comunidades e as equipes internas, assegurando que as informações circulem de maneira ágil e que as entregas sejam realizadas no prazo. Para ter sucesso nesse cargo, a pessoa precisa ser dinâmica, organizada, comunicativa e manter uma postura proativa diante de desafios, contribuindo diretamente para a eficiência e a consistência das operações.


No contexto da Bee2Be e da organização como um todo, esse cargo desempenha uma função estratégica ao garantir a execução das iniciativas na ponta, fortalecendo a relação com parceiros, promovendo padronização dos processos, assegurando a qualidade operacional e dando suporte contínuo para decisões baseadas em dados e evidências. O Assistente de Operações reforça a cultura de campo, aproxima a organização das comunidades atendidas e sustenta a base operacional necessária para escalar projetos com segurança e impacto.


Responsabilidades

O Assistente de Operações realiza visitas técnicas, acompanha atividades em campo, organiza dados operacionais, monitora metas e indicadores, apoia na implementação de planos de ação, articula com equipes e parceiros, registra informações de forma padronizada e contribui para a resolução rápida de problemas operacionais. Atua em alinhamentos internos, reuniões e ações de mobilização, garantindo que o projeto avance com ritmo, qualidade e consistência.


Qualificações

Para desempenhar esse papel, são desejáveis habilidades de organização, comunicação clara, relacionamento interpessoal, capacidade analítica e adaptabilidade. A pessoa precisa ter iniciativa, perfil mão na massa, habilidade para trabalhar com diferentes públicos e facilidade em lidar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas. Experiência prévia em operações, campo, projetos sociais ou produtivos, além de familiaridade com ferramentas digitais e coleta de dados, são diferenciais que fortalecem o desempenho no cargo.


Formação e Escolaridade

É necessário possuir ensino médio completo. Será considerado um diferencial ter formação técnica ou superior (completa ou em andamento) em áreas como Agropecuária, Agroecologia, Biologia, Zootecnia, Gestão Ambiental, Administração, Desenvolvimento Rural ou Gestão de Projetos. Essas formações contribuem para uma melhor compreensão das atividades em campo, e organização das rotinas operacionais, mas não são obrigatórias para a candidatura.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
About Turing



Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at



Role Overview:



We have an exciting opportunity for a Payroll Administrator to help with our growing global payroll processes. This role will own the Brazil payroll process but will be hands-on in many other aspects of our payroll operations through data collection, process streamlining, and entity creation. This is a great growth role for anyone wanting to expand their payroll career in a global setting.

Our ideal candidate is a hands-on self-starter who is analytical and methodical, with 4+ years of experience in payroll operations. We also value integrity, team spirit, and strong organizational skills.

This role is fully remote and based in Brazil, however, this role will be dealing with payroll across geographies as we grow.



Responsibilities:



  • Process Brazil payroll for employees in the Deel platform. This will include the monthly regular cycle and all off-cycle payrolls as needed for new hires/terminations.
  • Manage workflow to ensure incoming and outgoing payroll data is processed timely and accurately. Serve as the main point of contact for the Deel payroll team.
  • Remittance of Brazilian employee payroll deposits and monthly FGTS/INSS payroll tax payments.
  • Ability to understand union agreement(s) and serve as a point of contact for employee and/or vendor questions in relation.
  • Knowledge of Brazil payroll tax compliance to ensure the accuracy of system settings and processed transactions.
  • Help to ensure payroll-related tax account registrations are completed as needed.
  • Work closely with our internal accounting department to provide support on payroll-related questions or documentation as needed.
  • Own data collection, entries, and accuracy across multiple systems that impact global payroll operations.
  • Assist employees with inquiries related to payroll matters.
  • Assist with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end payroll processes and related tax reconciliations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with business partners (People/Benefits/Finance) for process improvements and efficiencies.
  • Create and/or maintain payroll documentation as it relates to processing, operational procedures, compliance, and other payroll-related matters.
  • Assist in ad-hoc duties when required (ie. audits, payroll backup for other entities, external payment operations, etc.)



Skills/Qualifications Required:



  • Minimum of 2-4 years of payroll processing.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with team members and other stakeholders.
  • Exposure to a SOX-regulated environment is preferred but not required.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and proven to have excellent time management skills to deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational skills;
    ability to meet deadlines across multiple tasks.
  • Recent processing experience with Deel or other third-party payroll providers. Exposure to ADP Workforce Now, HiBob, Slack, Jira, and Jibble preferred.
  • Knowledge of Sao Paulo Union agreements and Brazilian labor laws;
    must be able to read agreements and relay relevant information to team(s) as needed.
  • Strong communication skills, written/verbal, and the ability to interact with employees at all levels. Must be proficient in written and verbal English. Bilingual Portuguese preferred.
  • Strong MS Excel skills required (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, etc.)



Advantages of joining Turing:


  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
    5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely;
    able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role


This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities


  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results


  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements


  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

title: Rh Folha De Pagamento
description:
A Brunel apoia uma grande empresa do setor de Petróleo e Gás na busca por um Analista de RH Folha de Pagamento.


O profissional será responsável pelos processos de folha, encargos e obrigações acessórias, atuando de forma generalista na área de Administração de Pessoal e garantindo conformidade com legislação trabalhista, normas internas e boas práticas do setor.



Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na folha de pagamento end-to-end, incluindo cálculos, conferências e integração com sistemas internos.
  • Realizar rotinas de férias, rescisões, admissões, afastamentos, alterações contratuais e apuração de encargos (INSS, FGTS, IRRF).
  • Gerenciar e transmitir informações no eSocial , garantindo consistência e cumprimento de prazos legais.
  • Operar e parametrizar rotinas no ADP em nível médio a avançado, realizando análises e propondo melhorias.
  • Controlar processos de benefícios , integração de dados e interface com fornecedores.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas/externas e atender demandas de compliance e controles internos.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, indicadores da área e análises de inconsistências da folha.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato para áreas internas, fornecendo orientação sobre legislação e políticas de RH.
  • Contribuir para revisão de processos, padronização de rotinas e melhorias contínuas da área de Administração de Pessoal.



Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em folha de pagamento , encargos e rotinas de Administração de Pessoal.
  • Domínio de ADP .
  • Conhecimento de eSocial, legislação trabalhista e previdenciária.
  • Vivência generalista em RH: férias, rescisões, benefícios, movimentações e obrigações acessórias.
  • Experiência prévia em empresa de Óleo & Gás ou setores industriais de alta complexidade
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes, capacidade analítica e atuação consultiva.

title: Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Credit Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical, organized, and hands-on professional with strong leadership skills to coordinate the areas of Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit . This is a strategic position with a structured career path toward a Finance Manager role within up to 18 months , based on performance.

Key Responsibilities

Treasury

  • Prepare and monitor daily, weekly, and projected cash flow;
  • Manage bank accounts, balances, reconciliations, and financial investments;
  • Plan fund transfers between SPVs (SPEs) and partners;
  • Support Controllership with monthly close and cash flow projections;
  • Ensure banking security, proper segregation of duties, and approval levels.

Accounts Payable

  • Coordinate the full payment cycle (review, approval, and execution);
  • Ensure accurateposting of invoices, tax withholdings, and cost centers;
  • Implement and maintain payment policies;
  • Control due dates for contracts, insurance policies, and recurring expenses;
  • Monitor advances, corporate credit cards, and payment exceptions;
  • Support financial automation initiatives and accounting integration.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Coordinate billing (rent, charges, fees, and services);
  • Monitor delinquency, aging reports, collections, and postings in the ERP;
  • Implement preventive and corrective collection policies;
  • Support negotiations with customers and legal teams when required;
  • Develop management reports by property/project.

Credit

  • Implement and continuously review the company’s credit policy;
  • Perform customer financial and credit analysis;
  • Classify customers according to risk levels;
  • Monitor delinquency indicators and credit performance;
  • Train commercial and operational teams on credit rules and processes.

Management & Strategy

  • Develop financial dashboards and performance indicators;
  • Lead continuousimprovement and automation projects;
  • Act as the financial interface with partners, funds, and investors;
  • Conduct performance evaluations, develop successors, and build future leaders;
  • Act strategically alongside Controllership and Executive Management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or related fields;
  • Solid experience in Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit;
  • Experience working with financial ERP systems;
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills;
  • Leadership profile with autonomy and strategic mindset;
  • English proficiency is a plus (reading and speaking).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the real estate sector;
  • Experience managing financial flows between SPVs (SPEs);
  • Proven experience implementing financial automation.

What We Offer

  • Clear and structured career path toward a Finance Manager position;
  • Strong technical and strategic development environment;
  • Direct exposureto business financial decision-making.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
At MAVI, we connect top finance & accounting professionals with high-impact opportunities at US companies. Whether you’re looking for full-time or part-time projects, our network helps you define your next move.


Joining our invite-only network means:


  • Exposure to projects where your work makes a direct impact
  • Premium compensation compared to market alternatives
  • Opportunities with VC-backed startups & established US firms
  • Growth as part of an elite global community of professionals


Before working with clients, candidates complete our vetting process to join the MAVI network.


About the Role


We’ve partnered with a growing early childhood education provider that operates a nationwide network of child care centers. They are hiring a Senior Accountant to oversee end-to-end accounting operations across 20–30 centers and lead the transition from QuickBooks Online to NetSuite.

This is a high-impact role where you’ll combine hands-on accounting with process improvement, helping the organization scale as it continues to expand its footprint.


What You’ll Do


  • Lead and support the transition from QuickBooks Online to NetSuite (~70% complete), ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency
  • Manage full-cycle accounting operations: general ledger, AP, AR, reconciliations, and month-end close
  • Prepare and analyze financial statements, reports, and supporting schedules
  • Maintain and update loan schedules, insurance allocations, and related entries across operating entities
  • Categorize transactions in Ramp, Brex, and other systems (~1 day/month)
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to management for decision-making
  • Continuously improve accounting processes and leverage NetSuite functionality for efficiency gains
  • Handle other responsibilities typically expected of a Senior Accountant


What We’re Looking For


  • CPA or equivalent preferred
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on accounting experience
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting standards
  • Proficiency in NetSuite
  • Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and transition projects from QBO to NetSuite preferred
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills
  • Ability to operate independently while supporting a multi-entity, growing organization


Why Join Through MAVI?


  • 100% Remote
  • High-impact role supporting a fast-growing education services company
  • Competitive compensation aligned with global opportunities
  • Build your track record within the MAVI network


Selection Process


1️⃣ Initial Interview (20 min) – Meet with Sebastian (Talent Partner) and complete a short accounting exercise

2️⃣ Behavioral Interview (30 min) – Discuss your motivation and fit for working with MAVI clients

Successful candidates join the MAVI Talent Network and gain access to this and future opportunities.


Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion


MAVI provides equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or expression.

title: Aml/Cft Compliance Expert
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously enhance AML/CFT and sanctions policies in alignment with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Act as a primary compliance interface with regulators, including managing inspections, responding to inquiries, and executing remediation plans.
  • Perform risk-based customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews for both individuals and corporate clients.
  • Support ongoing monitoring activities, including transaction surveillance, sanctions screening, and the investigation of alerts or potentially suspicious behaviors.
  • Prepare, review, and submit Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other mandatory filings to COAF or relevant regulatory bodies.
  • Track legislative and regulatory developments related to AML/CFT and sanctions, and drive timely updates to internal policies and procedures.
  • Assist in delivering internal training programs to strengthen organizational awareness of AML/CFT and sanctions compliance obligations.
  • Conduct periodic AML/CFT risk assessments to validate control effectiveness and ensure alignment with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, audit trails, and recordkeeping for all compliance assessments, escalations, investigations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits as well as regulatory reviews, ensuring timely and accurate provision of information.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to enhance compliance systems, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and oversight of third-party service providers supporting AML/CFT and broader compliance functions.

Requirements

  • Must be legally residing in Brazil.
  • Minimum 7 years of senior-level AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience within financial services, fintech, or virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense , with sound judgment in escalation and decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of COAF, the Central Bank of Brazil, CVM regulations, and FATF recommendations.
  • Hands-on expertise in KYC/KYB processes, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or a related field;
    postgraduate studies orprofessional certifications (CAMS, ICA, etc.) strongly preferred.
  • Excellent analytical abilities, high ethical standards, and full professional fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must satisfy all fit-and-proper requirements, including:
  • No history of bankruptcy or insolvency;
  • An impeccable professional reputation;
  • Strong understanding of the crypto industry, including market dynamics and associated risks;
  • Technical competence aligned with the responsibilities of the role.

title: Cro Specialist
description:
Job Type: Remote

Location: Latin America

Availability: Full-time (Mandatory)


Description:

At Elevate Groups USA LLC, we are looking for a conversion architect—not a decorative designer. Your mission: build end-to-end landing pages that are not only visually premium but actually convert. You will be fully responsible for the strategy, design, development, and optimization.


What You’ll Do:

Design and develop landing pages on Shopify with clear conversion-focused narratives.

Implement and analyze A/B tests to optimize performance.

Create premium visual assets using Figma and AI tools.

Optimize page speed, UX, and conversion rates for each page.

Work with full autonomy—from research to deployment.

Essential Requirements


Mindset & Skills:

You think like a direct-response marketer (CRO frameworks, buyer psychology).

You can explain the “why” behind every design choice in terms of conversion.

Portfolio with actual URLs of Shopify pages you personally built.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.


Technical Skills:

Advanced Figma (components, prototyping, responsive design).

Shopify (Liquid, advanced CSS, JavaScript, speed optimization).

AI tools (Midjourney/Runway for asset generation).

A/B testing (implementation and analysis).


Nice to Have:

Experience in agencies, freelance, or growth marketing.

Familiarity with premium DTC aesthetics (e.G., Dr. Squatch, HiSmile).

Advanced CSS animations and micro-interactions.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role


This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities


  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results


  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements


  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

title: Bookkeeper

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

O seu dia a dia:

Organizar a agenda do executivo, controlando compromissos, reuniões, viagens e prazos;
secretariando o executivo, assessorando nas demandas diárias, triando assuntos, atendendo ligações nacionais e internacionais, controlando e-mails em português e inglês, recepcionando visitantes e apoiando logisticamente;
preparando e redigindo relatórios, cartas, comunicados, memorandos e documentos executivos em um ou mais idiomas;
realizando reservas de hotéis, passagens, transporte e providências logísticas para viagens e compromissos externos;
organizando reuniões internas e externas, incluindo convites, pautas, materiais de apoio e suporte aos participantes, bem como realizando demais atividades correlatas e inerentes ao cargo. Assessorar o Presidente de Controlada sendo um (a) facilitador (a) no que diz respeito às diversas tarefas desempenhadas por ele, dando todo o suporte necessário para busca dos resultados da Presidência. Principais Atividades/Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como interlocutor(a), em nome da presidência, com áreas de apoio (especialmente Comunicação);
  • Organizar a agenda do executivo, controlando compromissos, reuniões, viagens e prazos para assegurar o cumprimento eficiente das obrigações e apoiar a priorização estratégica da rotina;
  • Secretariar o executivo, assessorando-o nas demandas diárias por meio da triagem de assuntos, atendimento de ligações nacionais e internacionais, controle de e-mails em português e inglês, recepção de visitantes e apoio logístico completo;
  • Preparar e redigir relatórios, cartas, comunicados, memorandos e outros documentos executivos em um ou mais idiomas para garantir clareza, padronização e suporte às comunicações institucionais;
  • Realizar reservas de hotéis, passagens, transporte e demais providências logísticas para viagens e compromissos externos, garantindo pontualidade, organização e representatividade do executivo;
  • Organizar reuniões internas e externas, incluindo convites, pautas, materiais de apoio e suporte aos participantes para assegurar a fluidez dos encontros e a qualidade da experiência executiva;
  • Triar, priorizar e encaminhar e-mails, documentos e correspondências conforme critérios técnicos e normas internas para filtrar demandas, evitar sobrecargas e garantir que o executivo atue sobre os assuntos críticos no tempo necessário;
  • Manter atualizados os arquivos físicos e digitais do executivo, realizando classificação, etiquetagem, arquivamento e recuperação de documentos estratégicos para garantir rastreabilidade, integridade e segurança das informações;
  • Controlar, quando solicitado, atividades de apoio operacional, como serviços de copa, limpeza e organização da sala executiva, para assegurar ambiente adequado à condução das atividades de liderança;
  • Apoiar a comunicação com outros executivos, brasileiros ou estrangeiros, respeitando diferenças culturais e utilizando idioma apropriado para fortalecer a imagem institucional e facilitar o relacionamento internacional.


O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Transporte;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • PLR;
  • Wellhub;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).


Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

title: Collections Lead
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

As Collections lead, you will own the strategy that protects liquidity and strengthens trust in the Credix ecosystem. Operations runs the day-to-day recoveries;
your role is to define the strategy , policy, and data intelligence that make those efforts precise, fair, and scalable. You’ll guide how we balance recovery and relationships, when to engage, when to escalate, and when to step back.

You’ll refine our existing policy and performance frameworks, turning data into foresight and our network data into leverage - ensuring that Credix’s collections model becomes a competitive advantage, not just a control function.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in credit recovery in the context of Brazilian SMEs.
  • Proficiency with SQL and BI tools.
  • Ability to interpret cohort data and design actionable segmentation strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazil’s legal and judicial collection frameworks.
  • Clear communicator;
    able to translate data into field-ready direction.
  • Collaborative but decisive - able to guide Operations while respecting ownership.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a bias toward execution.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Responsibilities

  • Own the collections strategy and policy across all product lines.
  • Guide Operations: ensure day-to-day execution follows data-backed policy and economic logic.
  • Oversee complex recoveries and litigation, directly managing negotiations on high-value or reputationally sensitive cases.
  • Partner with the Data team to evolve our analytics layer - feeding insights from collections into credit models and underwriting.
  • Optimise the economic model of recovery: continuously measure ROI per effort type and segment.
  • Manage external partners (law firms, collection agencies) with a clear view of cost, compliance, and outcome quality.
  • Report and communicate results clearly to leadership and investors - recovery performance, portfolio health, and systemic learnings.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.
