title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role


This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities


  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results


  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements


  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...

Prestar assistência nos processos administrativos da área jurídica, auxiliando nos pagamentos e faturamentos da área, na emissão e lançamento de notas fiscais, organização de arquivos, controle de entrada e saída de correspondências e relatórios gerenciais.   • Atender clientes e/ou fornecedores e fornecer informações sobre produtos e serviços, identificar natureza das solicitações dos clientes, fornecer informações da empresa, registrar reclamações dos clientes, receber clientes e/ou fornecedores, identificar perfil dos clientes e/ou fornecedores, esclarecer dúvidas, solicitar documentos, coletar referências pessoais.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

description:
Código da vaga: 56054

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

  • Skills: Java21/Angular17
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com Spring (Boot, Data, Cloud, Security, etc)
  • Conhecimento em Filas (SQS) Conhecimentos em Git e Git-Flow
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDb)
  • Conhecimentos em AWS (Cognito, SQS, S3, ECS, Lambda, Api Gateway)
  • Desenvolvimento com foco em qualidade: testes unitários, testes integrados e Sonar (métricas) SOLID Clean code / Clean arquiteture
  • Experiência em micro serviços API Restfull Ambiente Linux
  • Vivência em Metodologia ágil Scrum/Kanban
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis (opcionais) Python Docker
  • Híbrido na Faria Lima (2x presencial na semana)- próximo ao metrô.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Secretária Executiva Ii
description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?


O Butantan é o maior produtor de vacinas e soros da América Latina e o principal fabricante de imunizantes contra a gripe (influenza) do hemisfério Sul. Referência mundial de eficiência e qualidade, também é responsável por grande parte da produção de soros hiperimunes e vacinas oferecidos à população gratuitamente pelo Programa Nacional de Imunizações (PNI), como as vacinas contra hepatite A, hepatite B, HPV, raiva e DTPA.


Aqui no Butantan, valorizamos a diversidade.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, que se traduz no respeito à diversidade de gênero, etnia, pessoa com deficiência, orientação sexual (LGBTQIAPN+), crenças e religiões. Buscamos pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores e que queiram crescer e se desenvolver junto com a instituição.


Buscamos um(a) profissional que atuará:


Principais atividades :


  • Organizar agendas e marcar reuniões internas e externas, adequando horários e compromissos para melhor estruturar o dia a dia do Superintendente;
  • Analisar, conferir, classificar, despachar, destinar e arquivar documentos, utilizando sistemas internos ou externos, de modo a transmitir pedidos, comunicados e divulgar decisões de forma transparente;
  • Manter a agendaatualizada e auxiliar no planejamento de compromissos, reuniões de diretoria, conferências e demais eventos;
  • Participar de reuniões e redigir atas;
  • Atender e selecionar chamadas telefônicas e fazer o direcionamento quando apropriado;
  • Lidar e priorizar toda a correspondência de saída ou entrada (e-mail, cartas, pacotes etc.);
  • Organizar viagens alinhando com departamento responsável;
  • Lidar com documentos confidenciais, garantindo que permaneçam seguros;
  • Preparar notas fiscais ou demonstrativos financeiros e prestar assistência na contabilidade;
  • Manter registros eletrônicos e em papel, garantindo que as informações sejam organizadas e facilmente acessíveis;
  • Realizar pesquisas e preparar apresentações ou relatórios, conforme atribuído, com o propósito de auxiliá-los na informação de diversos temas;
  • Organizar almoços, jantares e demais eventos visando o progresso e a divulgação do Butantan;
  • Solicitar veículos para transporte, cuidando de documentação e demais demandas recorrentes, como forma de garantir melhor desempenho no deslocamento;
  • Atender clientes externos e internos.


Formação e Requisitos Imprescindíveis:


  • Superior completo em Secretariado, Administração de Empresas ou áreas correlatas
  • No mínimo 7 anos de experiência em atendimento de CEO, diretores e presidentes
  • Fluência em inglês e em outros idiomas
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote office ( Word, excel, power point)


Nosso pacote de benefícios:


  • Oportunidade de carreira e desenvolvimento;
  • Convênio Médicoe convênio odontológico;
  • Plano de Aposentadoria Complementar:
  • TotalPass;
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo;
  • Cartão Ifood Benefícios;
  • Refeitório no local;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Ônibus fretado- Instituto Butantan/Metrô- Metrô/Instituto Butantan;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Auxílio para filho(a) com deficiência;
  • Auxílio para compra de material escolar;
  • Subsídio de medicamentos;
  • Parcerias na área Educacional e Entretenimento;
  • Acesso aos museus do Instituto Butantan;
  • Day Off de aniversário.


Informações complementares:


  • Período de inscrições: 08/11/2025 até 14/12/2025
  • Quantidade de vaga(s): 01
  • Local de Trabalho: São Paulo - Brasil
  • Horário de trabalho: comercial
  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% Presencial



Como serão as etapas do nosso processo seletivo :


O processo seletivo será composto pelas seguintes etapas:



  • Análise curricular e triagem de candidatos;
  • Entrevista com recrutadores;
  • Entrevista individual com o requisitante;
  • Entrevista individual com a gestão do(a) requisitante.



Todas as etapas são eliminatórias e podemos indicar uma ou mais etapas a informar no processo seletivo.


Validade do processo seletivo: 6 meses.

title: Assistente De Manutenção
description:
Resumo das atividades

Foco em Manutenção Residencial .

  • Executar manutenção corretiva elétrica, mecânica e hidráulica em máquinas, equipamentos e instalações, atendendo solicitações internas e de moradores, diagnosticando defeitos, através de manuais, desenhos e/ou avaliação técnica, substituindo peças e efetuando os ajustes necessários;
  • Realizar manutenção preventiva (mecânica, elétrica e hidráulica) baseando-se em checklist, inspecionando equipamentos de sistemas de refrigeração, funcionamento de bombas, caixa d’água, parte elétrica, geradores etc., detectando possíveis irregularidades, executando os reparos e informando o superior sobre os problemas detectados;
  • Utilizar, ferramentas e equipamentos apropriados para cada tipo de atividade, inclusive trabalhos em altura, fazendo uso dos acessórios de segurança exigidos, conforme legislação vigente;
  • Cuidar da segurança dos usuários, residentes e funcionários, durante a execução dos serviços de manutenção;
  • Prestar suporte técnico aos moradores e demais usuários, realizando manutenção corretiva/preventiva nos apartamentos;
  • Acompanhar leitura e registrar o consumo diário de gás, água e energia;
  • Inspecionar os equipamentos de combate a incêndio;
  • Solicitar e acompanhar visita técnica e manutenção realizada por terceiros;
  • Cumprir procedimentos relativos ao uso de EPI e EPC;
  • Zelar pela conservação dos materiais, ferramentas e equipamentos utilizados nos serviços de manutenção, requisitando sua reposição quando necessário;
  • Orientar profissionais de menor nível de experiência assim como fornecedores;
  • Executar pequenos serviços de alvenaria e marcenaria, quando necessário;
  • Registrar as manutenções efetuadas e todos os atendimentos realizados a moradores;
  • Executar outras atribuições correlatas de acordo com a necessidade da área;
  • Liderar e coordenar equipe de brigadistas, realizar ações de treinamento e procedimentos para o Edifício.
  • Controlar o estoque de materiais, peças, componentes, ferramentas e equipamentos, verificando quantidades e registrando em documentos e planilhas sua movimentação;

Qualificação

Ensino médio completo;

Desejável superior ou técnico em elétrica, refrigeração, mecânica, hidráulica;

Curso de NR10.

Habilidades

Capacidade resolutiva;

Comunicar-se deforma inclusiva e eficaz diante um público multicultural e amplamente conectado;

Organização para arquivar informações de maneira correta;

Proatividade emexecutar as manutenções.

title: Administrative Associate
description:
Primary Purpose of the Position

The Administrative Assistant reports to the ICT Director and is responsible for conducting tasks such as, but not limited to, managing contracts, licenses, and purchase orders;
controlling and planning budgets;
maintaining equipment inventory;
and providing support to expatriates.

The successful candidate is a customer service-oriented, hands-on professional who will coordinate office services and exercise independent judgment in resolving administrative problems. Maintains adequate inventory of all ICT supplies. Receives clients and directs them to the appropriate support person. Helps maintain a welcoming and professional environment.


Principal Duties and Responsibilities

Financial and Budgetary Control:

  • Receives, controls, and tracks IT orders and invoices.
  • Maintains spreadsheets and other documents related to the department for payment processing.
  • Adheres to payment deadlines, subscription renewals, and other time-sensitive due dates.
  • Supports daily budget monitoring and annual planning in collaboration with the ICT Director, Infrastructure Manager, and Applications Manager, helping identify opportunities for savings and renegotiations.

Support:

  • Organize ICT events that promote well-being and integration between the ICT team and other areas.
  • Work in partnership with different areas, being responsible for providing technology resources, follow-up, and continuous process improvement suggestions.
  • Provides the Head of divisions with reports on technology usage, such as printers, cellphones, and the internet.
  • Responds to questions from callers and walk-ins, directing the calls and customers to appropriate ICT staff as necessary.
  • Opens service tickets for repairs to computer equipment and peripherals, office equipment, furniture, and similar items, and monitors the status of each request through completion.
  • Helps ICT Management in maintaining equipment inventory.
  • Performs other ICT-related administrative duties as assigned by ICT Management.
  • Accepts general responsibility for the computer lab: stocks paper and toner in printers, pushes in chairs, selects recycling paper, fills staplers with staples, etc.

Administrative:

  • Creates and modifies documents, budgets, and other communications using a variety of office productivity software packages, including Microsoft Office and Google tools.
  • Performs general duties as photocopying, mailing, and filing.
  • Maintains hard copy and electronic filing system.
  • Collects and distributes general mail.
  • Purchases and stocks office supplies.
  • Coordinates purchasing and maintains budget control records.
  • Operates a personal computer to access email, electronic calendars, and other office support software.
  • Uses various software applications, such as spreadsheets and relational databases, to assemble, manipulate, and format data and reports.
  • Knows the standards, policies, and procedures, which may include familiarity with other departments within the school/division. Is sensitive to the interrelationship of both people and functions within the department.
  • Assist the Director of ICT with scheduling appointments, translation, and other administrative tasks.
  • Submit and reconcile expense reports

Expatriates Support:

  • In collaboration with ICT and Human Resources (HR) colleagues, supports expatriates in the selection and installation of home cable TV, Internet services, and Mobile Devices and Plans.
  • In collaboration with ICT and HR colleagues, coordinates cancellations/changes of service packages and address changes of cable TV & internet services.
  • Process billing for all these services.
  • Maintains electronic and payment records of all services.


Certifications and Education

Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, IT Management, or equivalent Area


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced English Level
  • Proven experience as an Administrative Assistant.
  • Knowledge of office management systems and procedures.
  • Working knowledge of office equipment, like printers, IP phones and copiers.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (MS Excel and MS PowerPoint, in particular)

Visão e Missão

Nosso propósito é: CONECTAR PARA TRANSFORMAR. Conectar VISÕES para transformar REALIDADES. Na VINCI Airports no Brasil, conectar é mais do que transportar – é criar elos que impulsionam mudanças positivas no mundo. Não apenas administramos aeroportos, criamos experiências que ampliam horizontes, oferecemos soluções que geram progresso e construímos um setor aeroportuário mais sustentável e inovador.

Formação e Requisitos

Graduação em Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.

  • Familiaridade com compliance contratual, SLAs e gestão de riscos;

Responsabilidades
  • Mapear, organizar e monitorar todos os contratos operacionais, incluindo vigência, valores, SLAs e conformidade legal;
  • Preparar, atualizar e acompanhar o cronograma anual de RFPs (Request for Proposals) da diretoria;
  • Implementar métodos de medição e controle de contratos, incluindo indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e relatórios periódicos;
  • Participar de auditorias internas nos contratos, identificando não conformidades e oportunidades de melhoria e propondo ações corretivas;

  • Apoiar na elaboração e revisão dos orçamentos anuais das gerências operacionais (CAPEX e OPEX);
  • Apoiar a realização de análises financeiras de OPEX e CAPEX;
  • Apoiar no monitoramento da execução dos OPEX e CAPEX;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar KPIs financeiros da diretoria;
  • Preparar relatórios gerenciais e análises comparativas de custos para subsidiar a tomada de decisão da Diretoria Operacional;

América do Sul, Brasil, Bahia. Cidade: São Cristóvão, Salvador - State of Bahia, Brazil.

A VINCI Airports, como a maior operadora privada de aeroportos no mundo, gerencia o desenvolvimento e as operações de 46 aeroportos localizados na França, em Portugal, no Reino Unido, na Suécia, Sérvia, no Camboja, no Japão, nos Estados Unidos, na República Dominicana, na Costa Rica, no Chile e no Brasil. Atendida por cerca de 250 companhias aéreas, a rede VINCI Airports transportou 240 milhões de passageiros em 2018. Por meio de sua expertise como um integrador abrangente, a VINCI Airports desenvolve, financia, constrói e opera aeroportos, aproveitando sua capacidade de investimento, network internacional e know-how para otimizar a gestão e o desempenho das infraestruturas aeroportuárias existentes, suas extensões e projetos de novas construções. title: Creative Director – Production Phase
description:
We’re seeking a Production Creative Director to own the entire production and post-production process for one of our YouTube channels .
You will lead animation quality, editing excellence, pacing, comedic timing, visual clarity, and all creative decisions that impact the final on-screen product.

This role is part of a co-director structure :

  • The Pre-Production Creative Director owns story vision, narrative direction, and script/story quality.
  • You own bringing that vision to life, transforming storyboards and scripts into polished, highly engaging final episodes.

Your mission is to elevate executional quality, ensure creative consistency, and maintain a high-performance standard across every video.

About the Role
  • Own the execution, pacing, animation direction, and final visual storytelling of every episode.
  • Ensure that all production elements faithfully and creatively bring the pre-production vision to life.
  • Create a consistent, efficient pipeline that blends creativity with operational excellence.
  • Set creative execution standards, templates, workflows, and visual identity guidelines for the channel.
What You’ll Do
  • Direct the animation and editing teams to ensure final output meets top-tier quality and channel identity.
  • Oversee pacing, comedic timing, visual clarity, transitions, hooks, and retention-driven editing choices.
  • Maintain creative alignment with the Pre-Production Creative Director to ensure continuity.
  • Review, approve, and refine all animatics, edits, animations, and final cuts.
  • Develop templates and style guides to streamline production.
  • Ensure the channel’s visual identity and animation style evolve strategically and consistently.
  • Troubleshoot production bottlenecks and improve pipeline efficiency.
  • Analyze top-performing videos and integrate learnings into future execution.
  • Mentor and guide animators, editors, and producers in best practices for YouTube animation.
About You
  • Strong background in animation direction, editing oversight, or creative production leadership.
  • Deep understanding of pacing, comedic timing, visual clarity, and YouTube storytelling.
  • Highly skilled at refining animatics, improving edits, and elevating final visuals.
  • Experience leading small-to-medium creative production teams.
  • Strong eye for detail, timing, motion, and cinematic rhythm.
  • Comfortable giving constructive, actionable feedback to animators and editors.
  • Highly organized, operationally-minded, and able to improve pipelines.
  • Passion for animation, storytelling, YouTube content, or digital-first production.
  • You love execution, pacing, and visual polish more than early ideation or narrative development.
What Makes This Role Exciting
  • Ownership of the entire visual execution and creative quality of the channel(s).
  • Ability to elevate the animation/editing identity from scratch or into a premium standard.
  • Collaboration with world-class creative, narrative, and production teams.
  • Huge opportunity to shape the final look, feel, and performance of videos seen by millions.

description:
Who is Recruiting from Scratch

Recruiting from Scratch is a premier talent firm that focuses on placing the best product managers, software, and hardware talent at innovative companies.

Our team is 100% remote and we work with teams across the United States to help them hire.

We work with companies funded by the best investors including Sequoia Capital, Lightspeed Ventures, Tiger Global Management, A16Z, Accel, DFJ, and more.

About Our Client

Our client is a gaming startup building an Anime-themed massively multiplayer dungeon building RPG game, blending the best qualities of top‑notch action games, role‑playing games, and game creation tools into one beautiful social experience.

They have raised over $17.5M in seed and Series A funding from a16z GPs.

Our client is currently seeing an explosion of interest in Anime in the US: Attack on Titan, Genshin Impact, League of Legends (Battle Academia skins) are early indicators of a greater long‑term trend.

As Anime fans themselves, they are incredibly excited to be building a 2.5D multiplayer world with an Anime-inspired theme, where players can make their own islands and games (starting with dungeons!) within a single shared world, and add custom art and stories to their creations.

About the Role

As a Lead Technical Artist, you will :

  • Work closely with the engineering and art teams to help turn their artists' vision of a beautiful, anime-themed world into reality
  • Create tools and pipelines for artists and game designers that will enable artists to efficiently test their ideas and implement their artwork in-engine
  • Build the no-code tools and interfaces that players will use to create their own dungeons, levels, and mods in their game world
Responsibilities
  • Set the foundation for the tools and workflows that will enable their art and engineering teams to implement their art vision in-engine
  • Help determine how we can best transform internal technology into user‑friendly UGC game creation tools for players to use
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to build tools and pipelines in Godot Engine
  • Write specific plugins and tools for external software such as Maya and Blender
  • Finish your mission and tasks with autonomy, occasionally taking on the role of a project lead or producer if necessary
Desired Qualifications
  • 5+ years of combined experience in technical art or software engineering roles
  • Specific experience creating user-friendly tools and pipelines tools & pipelines for non-technical artists and designers
  • Past experience with Maya or Blender, especially Maya art pipelines for game development
  • Understanding of modeling, texturing, VFX, and animation fundamentals
  • Expertise in modern programming languages such as C++, Python, and Go
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across engineering and art disciplines
  • Love of games, especially isometric action games such as Hades, MMORPGs like Lost Ark, or games in the sandbox / sim genres
Nice-to-Haves
  • 8+ years of experience in technical art
  • Significant C++ programming experience
  • Experience with Godot Engine
  • Abilities in any secondary areas such as modeling, rigging, animating, VFX, or lighting
  • Past experience working on cross-platform titles or MMORPGs
  • Familiarity with UGC game platforms and tools like Roblox, Rec Room, Halo Forge, RPG Maker, or Mario Maker
  • Love for anime and stylized cel-shaded 3D and 2D art styles, and past experience working on projects with kind of look
Perks and Benefits
  • Unlimited paid time off with 2-week vacation minimum
  • 100% employer-paid medical, vision, and dental insurance for the employee
  • Competitive tech industry pay
  • Flexible and remote work culture

$150,000 to $200,000

Nossa atuação abrange, desde a constituição de sociedades até a estruturação de operações societárias complexas, representando clientes nacionais e internacionais sempre com o real compromisso de atingir seus objetivos. Nosso atendimento abrange, também, a assessoria para cumprimento, por companhias abertas e outros emissores, de rotinas societárias, atendimento de ofícios, prestação de contas, divulgação de informações e realização de operações societárias perante Comissão de Valores Mobiliários – CVM e B3 S.A. – Bolsa Balcão Brasil. Como principais serviços, agregamos experiência na participação e assessoria em transações de compra e venda de empresas e ativos imobiliários e outros;
de investimento e financiamento, por meio da estruturação e formalização de arranjos societários, contratuais e de garantias;

About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA.

CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search / recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California.

We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.

What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it.

Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality... that's where CLS comes in!

Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence.

Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company's policies.

We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.

title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow‑up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands‑on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products
  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions
2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy
3. Own the Development Lifecycle
  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards
4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine‑tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base
REQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands‑on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)
2. Mindset & Approach
  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, ever‑changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self‑starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing
3. Highly Valued Qualifications
  • Experience with AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.
WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
  • Ground‑floor opportunity in a stealth‑mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale
2. Professional Excellence
  • Work alongside world‑class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting‑edge LLM technologies solving complex, real‑world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside
3. Work‑Life Integration
  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast‑paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability
READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search / recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.

What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality... that's where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company's policies.

We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.

Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses :

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now) : The total monthly compensation range is $4,200 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are :

  • Gym membership support : $105 BRL
  • Private health insurance support : $265 BRL
  • Home office and phone / high-speed internet service support : $160 BRL

Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. Work as a CLS HR & Investigation Assistant for a minimum of 1 year with competent performance and become eligible for promotion to the Specialist position.

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now) : The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are :

  • Private health insurance support : $265 BRL
  • Home office and phone / high-speed internet service support : $160 BRL

Starting total monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $9,000 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.

Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as :

  • High-performance bonus : When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co‑leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a "CLS Certified Investigator's Assistant" (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.

  • A Professional Bachelor's Degree in any field is required.
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.
  • 3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred.

Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST :
  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA.

CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search / recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California.

We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.

What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it.

Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality... that's where CLS comes in!

Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence.

Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company's policies.

title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear : enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers :

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

  • 1. Build and Refine AI Products

    Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

    Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

    Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

  • 2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

    Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

    Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

    Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

  • 3. Own the Development Lifecycle

    Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

    Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

  • 4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

    Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

    Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

    In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE
  • 1. Technical Skills

    Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

    Hands‑on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

    Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

    Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

    Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

    Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

  • 2. Mindset & Approach

    Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

    Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, ever‑changing startup environment

    Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

    A self‑starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

    Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end‑to‑end process from client data entry to insurance billing

  • 3. Highly Valued Qualifications

    Experience with AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

    Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

    Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

    Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

    Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management

    Healthcare Domain Knowledge : Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER
  • 1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

    Ground‑floor opportunity in a stealth‑mode company with massive market potential

    Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

    Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

  • 2. Professional Excellence

    Work alongside world‑class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

    Access to cutting‑edge LLM technologies solving complex, real‑world problems

    Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

    Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

  • 3. Work‑Life Integration

    Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

    Fast‑paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

    Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

    Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal‑level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow‑up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands‑on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products
  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions
2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy
3. Own the Development Lifecycle
  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards
4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine‑tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base
REQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands‑on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)
2. Mindset & Approach
  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, ever‑changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self‑starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing
3. Highly Valued Qualifications
  • Experience with AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.
WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
  • Ground‑floor opportunity in a stealth‑mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale
2. Professional Excellence
  • Work alongside world‑class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting‑edge LLM technologies solving complex, real‑world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside
3. Work‑Life Integration
  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast‑paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability
READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

  • Implementar e acompanhar projetos no contexto da operação, conforme diretrizes corporativas;
  • Analisar e mitigar riscos operacionais, com foco em segurança dos trabalhadores e conformidade ambiental.

Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência mínima de 10 anos em gestão de operações de mineração, preferencialmente em ouro, níquel, cobre, ferro ou operações em áreas remotas;
  • Experiência sólida em liderança de equipes e gestão operacional em mineração;

  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão em cenários complexos e sob alta pressão;
  • Boa comunicaçãoverbal e escrita em português;

title: Página Da Vaga | Gerente Regional Verdera
description:
Job description

Somos uma empresa de materiais de construção e soluções sustentáveis com mais de 13 mil empregados. Nossa trajetória começa em 1936, com a inauguração da nossa fábrica de Santa Helena, na cidade de Votorantim, no interior de São Paulo. Durante quase um século de existência, expandimos nossos negócios e mercados, cruzamos fronteiras e hoje somos uma das maiores empresas do setor no mundo. Atualmente, estamos presentes no Brasil e em mais dez países: Argentina, Bolívia, Canadá, Espanha, Estados Unidos, Luxemburgo, Marrocos, Tunísia, Turquia e Uruguai. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que faz, que acredita, que constrói. Sempre juntos e com excelência para chegarmos cada vez mais longe, entregando resultados sustentáveis e ajudando a construir um mundo melhor para todos. E você pode fazer parte disso! Conheça nossa unidade de negócio:

A Verdera é a unidade de gestão e destinação sustentável de resíduos da Votorantim Cimentos. Desde 1991, a empresa atua com coprocessamento e foi pioneira em trazer essa tecnologia para o Brasil. A Verdera atua na cadeia de soluções ambientais dando um novo valor para os resíduos. É um parceiro com alta capacidade de realização, que entende as particularidades de cada negócio e que está comprometido a fazer do jeito certo e a pensar de forma diferente para descobrir novas possibilidades que transformem a realidade de todos. Mais informações no site

Main responsibilities

Mapear oportunidades que permita a VC atuar como agente influenciador das políticas públicas e da legislação aplicada ao negócio, participando de fóruns regionais e grupos de discussão relacionados ao tema AFR e a outros correlacionados;

Suportar os agentes internos de negociação/influência junto às demais empresas do setor cimenteiro e ABCP no estabelecimento de ações de interesse comum das empresas do setor;

Identificar canais regionais de parcerias que visem a sustentabilidade do negócio e o seu desenvolvimento no longo prazo, tais como: Federação Indústrias Estaduais, Associações de Setores Econômicos ou de Indústrias que sejam potenciais geradores de resíduos ou biomassas para o negócio de coprocessamento da empresa;

Atuar como elo derelacionamento com o mercado regional e outros agentes públicos para o desenvolvimento do modelo de negócio da utilização Combustíveis Derivados de Resíduos (CDR) a partir de Resíduos Sólidos Urbanos;

Monitorar o resultado das ações de captação de novos volumes de coprocessamento;

Atuar como elo com os demais macroprocessos da Votorantim Cimentos, regionalmente, a fim de identificar práticas que possam ser aplicadas dentro do negócio de AFR e maximizar sinergias como forma de alavancagem de resultados;

Maximizar valor na cadeia, buscando diferenciação de serviços e posicionamento mais próximo de clientes estratégicos geradores de resíduos da regional;

Minimizar os custos de produção do Cimento e maximizar a geração de receitas alternativas por meio do serviço de destinação via coprocessamento e eficiência da cadeia logística, construindo percepção de valor do negócioVerderana regional;

Alavancar vantagem competitiva regionalmente por meio da maximização do uso de matéria-prima e combustíveis alternativos, desenvolvimento de fornecedores, clientes e apoiando iniciativas estratégicas, contribuindo para a inovação e o desenvolvimento tecnológico.

Requirements and skills
  • Gerir o cumprimento das políticas públicas e legislação aplicada ao negócio e participar de fóruns regionais e grupos de discussão relacionados ao tema AFR e outros correlacionados;
  • Liderar a adoção de ações de interesse comum do setor, visando um posicionamento que capture valor da cadeia no âmbito regional;
  • Apoiar a liderança nacional do negócio AFR na disseminação da temática Sustentabilidade na regional através de diversos canais estratégicos do setor, fortalecendo a visão do negócio no longo prazo;
  • Gerir as práticas empresariais voltadas à Sustentabilidade no setor por meio de parcerias estratégicas com Federação Indústrias Estaduais, Associações de Setores Econômicos ou de Indústrias que sejam potenciais geradores de resíduos ou biomassas para o negócio de Verderana regional;
  • Implementar a estratégia do modelo de negócio para utilização Combustíveis Derivados de Resíduos (CDR) a partir de Resíduos Sólidos Urbanos na regional;
  • Liderar e monitorar a busca pelo resultado das ações de captação de novos volumes de AFR e adotar medidas preventivas e corretivas que assegurem a maximização de tais volumes;
  • Maximizar sinergias internas junto aos demais macroprocessos da Votorantim Cimentos na regional;
  • Maximizar valorna cadeia buscando diferenciação de serviços e posicionamento mais próximo de clientes estratégicos geradores de resíduos na regional;
  • Minimizar os custos de produção do Cimento e maximizar a geração de receitas alternativas por meio do serviço de destinação via coprocessamento e eficiência da cadeia logística, construindo percepção de valor do negócioVerderana regional;
  • Alavancar vantagem competitiva regionalmente por meio do uso de matéria-prima e combustíveis alternativos, desenvolvimento de fornecedores, clientes e investindo em P&D e iniciativas estratégicas, fomentando inovação e desenvolvimento tecnológico;
  • Implementar a estratégia do negócio Verderana regional, bem como propor e executar obudgetdas áreas operacional e comercial da regional;
  • Zelar pela reputação da empresa diante da execução de todas as práticas regionais;
  • Assegurar a gestão de pessoas do negócio Verderana regional, incentivando o aproveitamento interno de talentos e provendo recursos para treinamento, avaliação de desempenho e engajamento das pessoas. Zelando sempre pelas crenças da Votorantim e incentivando sua aplicação diária;
  • Contribuir paradefinição e implementar as estratégias comerciais do negócio Verderana regional;
  • Maximizar a geração de valor na regional por meio da gestão da carteira de clientes / fornecedores, promovendo, negociando, comprando biomassas e vendendo serviços de coprocessamento, seguindo estratégias estabelecidas e cumprindo os resultados em conformidade com os procedimentos internos aplicados ao negócio;
  • Prospectar novos mercados e clientes regionalmente, visando a identificação de novas oportunidades de negócios, maximizando a geração de valor para o negócio por meio de iniciativas na cadeia;
  • Maximizar a rentabilidade dos principais clientes regionais, visando assegurar o cumprimento das metas de margem de contribuição e assegurar a negociação sustentável e o relacionamento de longo prazo;
  • Monitorar as ações da concorrência e tendências de mercado na regional, antecipando-se às oportunidades e riscos e agindo de forma assertiva frente à preservação da estratégia do negócio;
  • Atuar como responsável pela mitigação dos Riscos e pelo atendimento pleno das políticas de Compliance do negócio Verderana regional.

For more than 130 years, diversity, equity & inclusion (DEI) has been a part of our cultural fabric at Johnson & Johnson and woven into how we do business every day.

At Johnson & Johnson, we all belong.

We are searching for the best talent for Medical Director - Onco Hematology in Sao Paulo, Brazil.

The Local Head of Therapeutic Area mission is to provide Medical Affairs leadership for a specific TA in the country or cluster, owning and driving the overall medical strategy and plans for in‑line and pipeline products, in close alignment with internal business partners.

  • Leads, manages and coaches a local Medical Affairs team—Responsible for the TA strategy development and execution, healthcare compliance and budget management.

  • Responsible for all local publications.

title: Médico (A) Endocrinologista - Reserva Técnica (Inclusiva Para Pessoas Com Deficiência) - Floria...
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Na CASSI somos movidos pelo propósito que é o de “Cuidar do participante em todas as fases da sua vida”, ainda que fazemos parte de uma equipe de atividade meio ou fim, nosso propósito é único e sempre voltado ao participante da CASSI.

Por isso acreditamos que o (a) MÉDICO (A) ENDOCRINOLOGISTA não é somente um cargo, mas participa ativamente da construção de estratégias para uma CASSI cada dia melhor.

Precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a aprender e multiplicar conhecimento, avaliar e trocar ideias sobre o processo com a ótica de que podemos estar em constantes mudanças e melhorias.

Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão!

Todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de todos os perfis, incluindo pessoas com deficiência (PcD), pessoas negras, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+, 50+, entre outros grupos minorizados.

Caso você precise de algum recurso ou adaptação para participar do processo seletivo ou exercer suas atividades, por favor, informe no campo “Descrição das atividades”. Estamos comprometidos em oferecer um ambiente acessível e acolhedor para todos.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS
  1. Realizar assistência médica respeitando as premissas do Código de Ética Médica.
  2. Exercer atribuições conforme a política da CASSI.
  3. Realizar consulta e atendimento médico, por meio de anamnese, exame físico, solicitação e análise de exames complementares conforme estratégias, programas e diretrizes da CASSI.
  4. Emitir diagnósticos e aplicar recursos de medicina terapêutica e preventiva aos participantes.
  5. Efetuar e requisitar exames complementares de acordo com os protocolos estabelecidos e necessidade dos participantes.
  6. Interpretar resultados de exames de imagem, biométricos, hematológicos, bioquímicos e outros, comparando-os com os padrões normais com finalidade de emitir diagnóstico.
  7. Indicar e prescrever medicamentos e terapias, visando à prevenção e tratamento de doenças assim como a manutenção e promoção da saúde.
  8. Emitir atestados de saúde e aptidão física e mental, quando necessário.
  9. Emitir atestado médico com finalidade de afastamento das atividades habituais dos participantes, quando necessário.
  10. Realizar registro dos pacientes examinados no prontuário eletrônico do participante (PEP), anotando a anamnese, exame-físico, resultados de exames, hipótese diagnóstica, tratamento, orientações e evolução da doença.
  11. Ser, quando indicado pela CASSI, o responsável técnico em sua área de atribuição, perante órgãos diversos.
  12. Realizar atendimento de urgência e emergência, sempre que necessário, no âmbito da CliniCASSI.
  13. (+ ) Realizar interconsulta com outros profissionais de saúde, sempre que necessário.
  14. Participar de programas e atividades de educação em saúde, articulado com equipe da APS, com vistas à melhoria da saúde do participante.
  15. Elaborar relatórios e laudos técnicos em sua área de especialidade, sempre que necessário.
  16. Realizar a notificação compulsória de doenças, sempre que necessário.
  17. Participar de discussão de casos clínicos, sempre que necessário.
  18. Participar de campanhas educativas nos campos da saúde pública e da medicina preventiva.
  19. Prestar informações do processo saúde-doença aos participantes e a seus familiares.
  20. Realizar diagnóstico da comunidade Cassi e levantar indicadores de saúde para avaliação do impacto das ações em saúde implementadas.
  21. Orientar e zelar pela preservação e guarda dos equipamentos, aparelhos e instrumentais utilizados em sua especialidade, observando a sua correta utilização.
  22. Utilizar equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI) conforme preconizado pela ANVISA.
  23. Orientar os colaboradores que o auxiliam na execução das tarefas típicas do cargo.
  24. Participar na elaboração do planejamento do serviço, seguindo as diretrizes da CASSI.
Atribuições
  1. Realizar atendimento médico aos participantes na área de endocrinologia, seguindo protocolos e diretrizes da Cassi.
  2. Realizar suporte técnico (treinamento, interconsulta, discussão de caso) às equipes da APS na área de endocrinologia.
  3. Realizar matriciamento com a equipe de saúde da APS.
  4. Participar da elaboração de protocolos clínicos.
  5. Acolher, realizar diagnóstico e propor tratamento em sua área de especialidade aos participantes encaminhados pela equipe APS conforme plano de compartilhamento do cuidado na atenção primária.
  6. Realizar acompanhamento dos participantes com as principais doenças endócrinas (diabetes, obesidade, dislipidemia) e propor alternativas para melhoria da qualidade de vida.
  7. Realizar encaminhamento externo conforme oferta e tipo de serviço previamente pactuado com a APS seguindo linhas de cuidado e respeitando o rol de cobertura do plano.
  8. Referenciar primariamente os profissionais da APS para quaisquer novos problemas de saúde identificados.
REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONSPRÉ-REQUISITOS
  • Ensino Superior completo em Medicina.
  • Registro no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM).
  • Residência médica em Endocrinologia ou Título de Especialista em Endocrinologia com Registro de Qualificação de Especialista (RQE) emitido pelo CRM.
  • Experiência na área de Endocrinologia.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
  • A vaga é destinada para Reserva Técnica.
  • Salário : R$ 10.257,16 (após o período de experiência)
  • Carga horária : 20 horas semanais
  • Vaga 100% presencial
BENEFÍCIOS
  • Cesta alimentação : R$ 498,48
  • Vale refeição / alimentação : R$ 875,82
  • Plano de saúde (opcional)
  • Previdência Privada (opcional)
  • Oferecemos licença maternidade de até 6 meses
  • Licença paternidade de até 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche
Observação
  • Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com o modelo de contrato. As informações devem ser confirmadas durante a entrevista.
  • O candidato tem a responsabilidade legal pelas informações registradas na inscrição, podendo a CASSI, a qualquer tempo durante a seleção, exigir documentação que comprove os requisitos obrigatórios da vaga.
Caixa de Assistência dos Funcionários do Banco do Brasil

A CASSI foi fundada em 27 de janeiro de 1944 por um grupo de funcionários do BB, com o objetivo de ressarcir as despesas de saúde dessa população. Nestas oito décadas, a Empresa experimentou grande desenvolvimento, tornando-se uma das maiores instituições sem fins lucrativos administradoras de planos de saúde do País. As 27 Unidades, instaladas em todos os Estados do País, proporcionam atendimento acolhedor e diferenciado.

O diferencial da Caixa de Assistência está na proposta de atendimento integral, focado na promoção da saúde e na prevenção de doenças, por meio da Estratégia Saúde da Família. Assim, é pioneira entre os planos de saúde brasileiros na oferta de programas e atividades coletivas em saúde, voltados para melhoria dos hábitos de vida, nutrição, atividade física, realização de consultas periódicas e exames de rotina, além de proporcionar o acompanhamento adequado dos portadores de doenças crônicas.
